About Colin Jost

Colin Jost is an American comedian, writer, and actor widely known for his work as a head writer on the popular sketch comedy show "Saturday Night Live" (SNL). With his sharp wit, intelligent humor, and undeniable charm, Jost has become one of the most beloved and recognizable figures in the entertainment industry today.  
  
Born and raised in Staten Island, New York, Colin Jost discovered his passion for comedy at a young age. While attending Harvard University, he became heavily involved in the school's comedy scene, performing stand-up and writing for the well-renowned Harvard Lampoon. Jost's comedic talents were immediately evident, and his performances garnered him recognition and opportunities within the industry.  
  
After graduating from Harvard, Jost moved to Los Angeles to pursue a career in comedy writing. His breakthrough came in 2005 when he was hired as a writer for "Saturday Night Live." Jost quickly proved himself to be an exceptionally talented writer, earning promotions and eventually becoming the head writer of the show in 2012. During his tenure, he has been responsible for creating some of SNL's most iconic sketches, including fan favorites like "Weekend Update" and "The Girl You Wish You Hadn't Started a Conversation with at a Party."  
  
One of Jost's most notable contributions to "Saturday Night Live" has been his work as a co-anchor on the Weekend Update segment. Alongside his former SNL co-star Michael Che, Jost delivers hilarious and insightful commentary on current events, politics, and pop culture. His delivery is often deadpan, striking a perfect balance between sarcastic and sincere, and his clever wordplay never fails to entertain audiences.  
  
Beyond his work on SNL, Colin Jost has also made significant contributions to the world of stand-up comedy. He has released a comedy special titled "Colin Jost: Live From New York," in which he showcases his comedic skills and ability to connect with audiences through his relatable and witty observations. Jost's stand-up performances are infused with his signature dry humor, providing audiences with a delightfully humorous experience.  
  
Jost's talent extends beyond the world of comedy writing and performing. He has authored a memoir titled "A Very Punchable Face: A Memoir," in which he recounts various anecdotes about his life, from his childhood antics to his experiences working on SNL. The book offers readers an intimate and humorous glimpse into Jost's world, showcasing his talent for storytelling and his unique perspective on life.  
  
While Jost is primarily known for his comedic work, he has also ventured into the world of acting. He has appeared in films such as "How to Be Single" and "Staten Island Summer," showcasing his versatility as a performer. Jost's effortless charisma and natural comedic timing have translated seamlessly into his acting career, further establishing him as a well-rounded entertainer.  
  
Offstage, Colin Jost is known for his relationship with actress Scarlett Johansson, whom he married in 2020. The couple's union has attracted significant media attention, catapulting Jost into the spotlight even further. Despite his newfound fame, Jost remains down-to-earth and focused on his craft, continually honing his skills as a comedian and writer.  
  
Colin Jost's ability to effortlessly blend intelligence, wit, and charm has solidified his role as one of the entertainment industry's most prominent figures. Whether he's cracking jokes on SNL, performing stand-up, or starring in films, Jost's comedic prowess never fails to captivate audiences. With a promising career ahead and an undeniable talent for making people laugh, Colin Jost continues to leave an indelible mark on the world of comedy and beyond.

About Southern California Law Review
------------------------------------

The Southern California Law Review, USC Gould's flagship journal, was established in 1927. Staff members are chosen on the basis of the annual Write-On competition and the staff of the Law Review assists in the preparation of scholarly articles and student-written notes for publication.  
  
The Law Review has three goals: (1) to advance legal scholarship through the publication of outstanding articles; (2) to foster a sense of intellectual community and professional camaraderie among members of the Law Review and the faculty of the law school; and (3) to train Law Review members in legal analysis and writing. The Law Review publishes one volume annually, produced as six separate issues. Each issue contains articles written by leading scholars and student notes written by Law Review staff members. In addition, the Law Review has a tradition of co-hosting symposia and events with the law school to explore broad topics relevant to the legal field.

About H.I.G. Capital
--------------------

H.I.G. Capital is a leading global private investment firm with $59 billion of equity capital currently under management.\* H.I.G.'s family of funds includes private equity, real estate, growth equity and debt/credit. H.I.G. Capital has invested in and controlled over 400 organizations globally since it was founded more than 20 years ago. The firm currently manages a portfolio of companies with combined sales in excess of $52 billion.  
  
H.I.G. is based in Miami, with offices in New York, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Atlanta in the U.S., and affiliate offices in London, Hamburg, Madrid, Milan and Paris in Europe as well as Rio de Janeiro, Bogotá and São Paulo in South America.  
  
H.I.G. focuses on providing capital to small and mid-sized businesses with attractive growth potential. The firm invests in management-led buyouts and recapitalizations of well-managed and profitable manufacturing and service businesses.  
  
H.I.G. Capital also has extensive experience with operational turnarounds and financial restructurings. The firm has a proven strategy built around; (1) a flexible investment approach which emphasizes speed as well as responsiveness; (2) a large team with unique skills and capabilities, as well as a "can-do"​ approach; (3) a long-standing focus on small and medium sized businesses typically from $50-500 million in value, as well as an understanding of the challenges and opportunities these business present.  
  
\* Based on total capital commitments managed by H.I.G. Capital and affiliates.

About INDIA TV (Independent News Service Pvt Ltd)
-------------------------------------------------

The rise of India TV as India’s leading news channel within a short span of its existence owes a lot to the vision of its Chairman and Editor-in-Chief Rajat Sharma and the dedication and toil of its ever-growing team of bright news TV professionals.  
  
Rajat Sharma co-founded India TV with his wife Ritu Dhawan in April, 2004 from a swanky studio in Film City, Noida, then considered one of Asia’s largest news TV studios.  
  
In 1997, Rajat Sharma and Ritu Dhawan set up their own production house –Independent News Service (INS), the parent company which owns India TV.  
  
In a short period, India TV has created benchmarks in innovation, impact, ratings, time spends, and viewer-support. Indeed, India TV’s newsbreaks have inspired talk shows on rival channels, Bollywood films, BBC documentaries and articles in Time Magazine, even Amul hoardings.  
  
In today’s rampant me-too-ism, India TV is, perhaps, the only Hindi news channel that is perceived as “courageous” and “different.”  
  
The channel’s No.1 position is no accident. It is the result of Mr. Sharma leading the way on the lonely path of “credibility first.” It is the result of the efforts of a self-made man who kept both his feet firmly to the ground, a journalist for whom the viewer’s interest has been paramount.  
  
India TV has state-of-the-art digital connectivity and its Broadcast Centre covers an area of more than 1,28,000 square feet in Sector 85, Noida.

As the lead vocalist and guitarist of the acclaimed band Mumford & Sons, he has captivated audiences around the world with his impassioned performances and introspective lyrics. Born on January 31, 1987, in Anaheim, California, Marcus John Christopher Mumford grew up immersed in a rich musical environment that shaped his artistic sensibilities.  
  
Mumford was raised in a family of musicians, with his parents both being prominent figures in the British folk music scene. His father, John Mumford, was a well-known musician and pastor, while his mother, Eleanor Mumford, was an educator and worship leader. Growing up, Marcus was surrounded by traditional folk music, gospel choirs, and the vibrant energy of the London music scene, which undoubtedly influenced his own musical endeavors.  
  
From a young age, Mumford displayed a deep connection with music, starting with the drums at the age of six. He quickly developed a passion for playing and soon added guitar and mandolin to his repertoire. While attending King's College School in Wimbledon, he joined a punk-rock band called "Laura Marling and the Rebirth" alongside future collaborator and fellow British singer-songwriter, Laura Marling.  
  
Upon graduating from school, Mumford immersed himself in the London music scene, which was experiencing a revival of folk-inspired bands. Drawing inspiration from legends like Bob Dylan and Leonard Cohen, he began crafting his own songs, weaving together introspective, poetic lyrics with memorable melodies. His earnestness and raw talent quickly caught the attention of both critics and fellow musicians, leading to collaborations with established artists, such as Noah and the Whale and Johnny Flynn.  
  
In 2007, Marcus Mumford formed Mumford & Sons with banjo player Winston Marshall, keyboardist Ben Lovett, and bassist Ted Dwane. Together, they embarked on a remarkable musical journey, breaking into the mainstream with their debut album, "Sigh No More," released in 2009. The album's blend of folk instrumentation, anthemic choruses, and introspective storytelling resonated with listeners on a profound level.  
  
Mumford's emotive vocals and deeply personal lyrics added an unmistakable soulfulness to the band's sound, earning them a devoted following and critical acclaim. The album's breakout hits, "Little Lion Man" and "The Cave," showcased Marcus's ability to convey vulnerability and strength in equal measure, while his exceptional songwriting skills illuminated his introspective nature.  
  
Over the years, Mumford & Sons have continued to astound audiences with their heartfelt performances and thought-provoking lyrics. Their subsequent albums, "Babel" (2012), "Wilder Mind" (2015), and "Delta" (2018), demonstrated the band's evolving sound while maintaining the core elements that made them famous – Marcus Mumford's distinctive voice and his poetic songwriting.  
  
Beyond his contributions to Mumford & Sons, Marcus Mumford has collaborated with a wide range of artists, including the likes of British singer Birdy, contemporary Christian worship group Hillsong United, and iconic musician Elton John. The college offers a diverse array of bachelor's, master's, and associate degrees, along with various certificates tailored to meet the needs of working professionals and adult learners. With a strong emphasis on accessibility and convenience, Charter Oak State College enables students to balance their education with personal and professional commitments.

Founded in 1881, Concordia University Wisconsin's main campus is located on approximately 200 acres of beautiful Lake Michigan shoreline at 12800 N. Lake Shore Drive, Mequon. The University and its 10 Accelerated Learning Centers and classroom locations are home to more than 7,200 undergraduate and graduate, traditional, as well as non-traditional students from 46 states and 30 countries. About Fabco Shoes
-----------------

Headquartered in Queens, NY with 54 stores, Fabco has distinguished itself as the local leader in providing fashionable footwear at affordable prices for men, women, and children. Fabco Shoes was founded in 1953 by Abe Weinman and Fred Lustbader, both veterans of the discount footwear industry. They were professional colleagues manufacturing, selling, and retailing shoes. Both Abe and Fred shared a vision to establish a self-service shoe store with fashionable family footwear at affordable prices. Their first store opened in Brooklyn and soon after they expanded to New York’s five boroughs, Long Island, and New Jersey. Fabco maintains this vision and is now operated by the founders’ children.  
  
Fabco values its customers by providing quality footwear at competitive prices. Our brands and styles are tailored to fit all walks of life, from sophisticated fashion to trusted comfort. We are able to respond quickly to trends and new designs, bringing to our customers the best product and value. For women, popular silhouettes include sandals, pumps, flats, boots, and back-to-school styles. Our loyal customers value our strong selection of children’s footwear including popular branded characters. Fabco’s men’s selection is unparalleled when it comes to price and assortment, especially for work and winter-weather boots. In addition, Fabco carries a complete line of handbags, jewelry, legwear, and other fashion accessories for the entire family.

About Kyle Schwarber

Kyle Schwarber is an electrifying American baseball outfielder known for his raw power and clutch performances on the field. Born and raised in Middletown, Ohio, Schwarber developed a passion for the game at a young age and quickly rose through the ranks to become one of the most exciting players in Major League Baseball (MLB).  
  
Standing at an impressive 6 feet tall and weighing in at around 235 pounds, Schwarber possesses a formidable presence at the plate. With a powerful left-handed swing, he has the ability to launch balls into the stratosphere, much to the delight of fans and teammates alike. His towering home runs have become a trademark of his game, often leaving audiences in awe and opposing pitchers in despair.  
  
Schwarber's journey to the big leagues began during his time at Indiana University, where he played college baseball for the Hoosiers. As a junior, he earned the distinction of being a First Team All-American and was a key factor in leading the team to their first College World Series appearance in school history. His stellar performances caught the attention of MLB scouts, and in 2014, he was selected fourth overall by the Chicago Cubs in the MLB draft.  
  
The young outfielder wasted no time making his mark in the majors. He made his MLB debut in 2015 and immediately showcased his talent, hitting sixteen home runs in only 69 games. Schwarber's impact on the team was evident during the Cubs' historic run to the World Series that same year. Despite suffering a season-ending injury early in the season, he returned in time for the Fall Classic and became a pivotal part of the Cubs' offense. His heroics included a dramatic Game 4 performance, where he blasted a game-tying home run that fueled the team's eventual victory and helped them win their first World Series title in over a century.  
  
After a couple of injury-marred seasons, Schwarber bounced back in 2019 to produce one of his best performances. He recorded a career-high 38 home runs and 92 runs batted in, establishing himself as a force to be reckoned with in the league. His ability to come through in clutch moments earned him the nickname "Schwarbomb", and he became a fan favorite in Chicago for his never-give-up attitude and unwavering determination.  
  
In 2021, Schwarber took his talents to the Washington Nationals, signing a one-year contract with the team. He wasted no time making an impact, hitting twelve home runs in his first ten games, setting a new MLB record for the most home runs in that span. His remarkable power surge earned him the National League Player of the Month award for June, further solidifying his status as one of the league's premier power hitters.  
  
Beyond his on-field exploits, Schwarber also possesses a humble and team-oriented mentality. Known for his strong work ethic and dedication, he is often the first to arrive at the ballpark and the last to leave. His infectious enthusiasm and uplifting presence in the clubhouse have endeared him to teammates and coaches alike, making him a respected leader and valued member of any team he represents.  
  
Whether it's launching moonshot home runs or inspiring his teammates with his unwavering determination, Kyle Schwarber has become a modern icon in American baseball. With his powerful swing, clutch performances, and a drive to continuously improve, he has proven himself as one of the game's most exciting and dynamic players. About Navy Pier

Navy Pier is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit corporation established in 2011 to maintain Chicago's historic Navy Pier and oversee the redevelopment of one of the most important civic landmarks in the United States and the top-visited leisure destination in the Midwest. Looking ahead to Navy Pier’s 100th anniversary in 2016, Navy Pier created The Centennial Vision, a framework for reimagining Navy Pier. Grounded in the noble principles of its founding designers, The Centennial Vision adds a visionary and contemporary lens for the future.  
  
Navy Pier's mission to be a world-class public place that celebrates and showcases the vitality of Chicago and provides for the enjoyment of Chicago-area residents and visitors year-round. NPI manages Navy Pier within a business framework that provides for its long-term financial stability.  
  
While looking forward to what is relevant for Chicagoans today, Navy Pier leadership is ever conscious of famed architect Daniel Burnham’s vision to transform the lakefront into attractive and useful public space for active recreation and social interaction – a source of pride and common ground that fosters a sense of community within the city’s diverse population.  
  
Navy Pier's objectives for the future remain consistent with Burnham’s enduring values for the ‘People’s Pier’ to be a place where local residents and visitors from around the world come to experience the natural beauty of the lakefront and Chicago’s magnificent skyline.

About Liv Tyler

Liv Tyler is a mesmerizing American actress whose talent and beauty have captivated audiences around the world. With her ethereal features, flowing dark locks, and piercing blue eyes, she has become an iconic figure in the world of Hollywood. As the daughter of rock legend Steven Tyler, Liv was born into the spotlight, but she has carved her own path in the industry, establishing herself as a force to be reckoned with.  
  
Born on July 1, 1977, in New York City, Liv Rundgren Tyler was raised by her mother Bebe Buell, a model and singer-songwriter. Her unique upbringing exposed her to an array of artistic influences, nurturing her passion for performance from a young age. Liv's biological father, Steven Tyler, the legendary frontman of rock band Aerosmith, initially had no knowledge of Liv being his daughter until she was around eight years old. However, once he discovered the truth, he developed a close bond with her, even walking her down the aisle on her wedding day.  
  
Liv's acting career took off in the mid-1990s when she made her big screen debut in Bernardo Bertolucci's acclaimed film "Stealing Beauty." This coming-of-age tale showcased her raw talent and undeniable screen presence, establishing her as a rising star in Hollywood. Liv's delicate beauty and emotional depth brought her critical acclaim, garnering attention from both critics and audiences alike.  
  
Perhaps one of her most iconic roles came in the form of Arwen Undómiel in Peter Jackson's fantasy epic, "The Lord of the Rings" trilogy. Portraying the elven princess, Liv brought grace, strength, and vulnerability to the character, capturing the hearts of millions of fans worldwide. Her portrayal resonated with viewers, as she embodied the timeless beauty and ethereal nature of the elves.  
  
Liv continued to make waves in the film industry with her stunning performances in various genres. In "Armageddon," she starred alongside Bruce Willis as his daughter, captivating audiences with her emotional portrayal of a young woman facing the impending destruction of Earth. Liv showcased her versatility as an actress in the haunting film "The Strangers," playing a terrified victim of a home invasion, delivering a spine-chilling performance that left audiences on the edge of their seats.  
  
Beyond her film career, Liv has also made a notable impact on the fashion and beauty industry. With her classic elegance and impeccable style, she has been a muse for renowned designers such as Givenchy and Thierry Mugler. Liv's timeless beauty has graced numerous magazine covers, cementing her as a fashion icon in her own right.  
  
Outside the limelight, Liv is a dedicated philanthropist, actively involved in charitable causes. She has been an ambassador for the United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) since 2003, advocating for children's rights and supporting various initiatives to improve their lives. Liv's empathetic nature and passion for making a difference have earned her great respect and admiration.  
  
Liv Tyler's talent, beauty, and philanthropy have made her a beloved figure both on and off the screen. With her remarkable performances and commitment to making the world a better place, she has left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry. Liv's magnetic presence and ability to capture the essence of her characters make her a true Hollywood icon, ensuring her place in the hearts of audiences for years to come.

Eknath Shinde, the 20th Chief Minister of Maharashtra, has emerged as a pivotal figure in the state's political landscape, particularly in the realms of leadership and public policy. Hailing from the Maratha community and having deep roots in Thane, Shinde's journey from humble beginnings to the highest office in the state reflects his resilience and commitment to public service. Since assuming office, he has focused on key projects aimed at enhancing infrastructure, improving governance, and fostering economic development across Maharashtra.  
  
Under Shinde's leadership, the Government of Maharashtra (GoM) has prioritized initiatives such as the Mumbai Coastal Road Project and the development of the Mumbai Metro, which are crucial for urban mobility and reducing congestion in one of India's busiest cities. His administration has also emphasized the importance of digital governance, implementing e-governance solutions to streamline public services and increase transparency. This commitment to modernization aligns with his expertise in organizational leadership and administration, enabling him to navigate complex bureaucratic structures effectively.  
  
Moreover, Shinde's political acumen has been instrumental in fostering alliances and ensuring stability within the state's coalition government. His ability to engage with diverse stakeholders—from local communities to business leaders—underscores his skills in negotiation and consensus-building, which are vital in the multifaceted realm of politics. As he continues to steer Maharashtra towards a more prosperous future, Eknath Shinde's vision and strategic initiatives are set to leave a lasting impact on the state's development trajectory.

Wind River Systems also provide a medical device development software portfolio. It provides Wind River Network Acceleration Platform for networking performance; Wind River Platform for Gateways to develop smart gateways; and other simmilar products. Wind River Systems serves aerospace and defense, automotive, consumer, industrial, and telecommunication network equipment industries. It has a strategic partnership with Altera Corporation. It was established in 1981, with its headquarters in Alameda, California. Currently , it operates as a subsidiary of Intel Corporation.

About Mark Levin

Mark Levin is an influential and dynamic figure in American broadcasting, renowned for his conservative viewpoints and insightful analysis of political and social issues. As a nationally syndicated radio host, author, and lawyer, his impressive career spans multiple mediums and has earned him a loyal following of listeners and readers.  
  
With his distinct blend of intelligence, wit, and unwavering commitment to traditional conservative values, Levin has attained widespread recognition for his influential voice in the media landscape. His radio show, "The Mark Levin Show," airs nationwide and consistently ranks amongst the top radio programs in the United States. Through thought-provoking discussions and thoughtfully articulated arguments, Levin tackles a wide range of topics, including constitutional law, government overreach, media bias, and the role of individual liberty.  
  
Levin's expertise and credentials extend beyond his role as a broadcaster. He began his career as a lawyer, earning his Juris Doctorate from Temple University School of Law. As an attorney, he served in various governmental positions, including Chief of Staff for Attorney General Edwin Meese during the Reagan administration. This experience deeply influenced his political philosophy and understanding of the legal system, shaping the foundation of his conservative beliefs.  
  
In addition to his radio career, Levin is a successful author. His books, including "Liberty and Tyranny: A Conservative Manifesto" and "Ameritopia: The Unmaking of America," have become bestsellers, captivating audiences with his well-researched arguments and passionate prose. These works deftly explore the intersection of history, philosophy, and politics, shedding light on the erosion of American values and the importance of preserving individual freedom.  
  
One of Levin's defining qualities is his ability to break down complex political and legal concepts into digestible and relatable terms. Through his dynamic speaking style and polished delivery, he engages listeners of all backgrounds, conveying his ideas with precision and clarity. Whether discussing the impact of a Supreme Court ruling or dissecting the flaws in a proposed policy, Levin has an innate talent for connecting with his audience and fostering a sense of intellectual curiosity.  
  
Beyond his intellectual prowess, Levin's captivating personality draws people in, creating a sense of camaraderie and connection with his audience. He possesses an unmistakable passion for his beliefs, which amplifies the impact of his arguments and energizes his listeners. In an era of polarizing political discourse, Levin's ability to engage in thoughtful, respectful discussion has made him a respected and sought-after commentator.  
  
Levin's influence extends far beyond the radio waves, as he remains a prominent figure in the conservative movement. His contributions to the field have not gone unnoticed, earning him numerous accolades including the American Conservative Union's Ronald Reagan Award, recognizing his commitment to conservative principles and his dedication to advancing the conservative movement's goals.  
  
In a media landscape often dominated by sensationalism and partisan rhetoric, Mark Levin stands out for his unwavering dedication to truth, reason, and conservative principles. Through his radio show, bestselling books, and insightful commentary, he has established himself as a profound voice in American broadcasting. Whether one agrees with his perspectives or not, Levin offers intellectual stimulation and sparks robust conversations, making him a force to be reckoned with in the world of conservative media.

What types of wealth management services does Julius Baer offer?

Julius Baer specializes in comprehensive wealth management services tailored to meet the unique needs of high-net-worth individuals and families. Our offerings include investment advisory, private banking, structured products, and discretionary mandates. We also provide holistic advice that encompasses wealth planning, sustainable investing, and Lombard lending, ensuring that our clients' financial goals are met with a personalized approach.

How does Julius Baer approach sustainable investing?

At Julius Baer, we recognize the importance of sustainable investing and its impact on long-term financial performance. Our sustainable investment strategies focus on integrating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) criteria into the investment process. We offer a range of sustainable investment products and solutions, allowing clients to align their portfolios with their values while pursuing attractive returns.

What is the process for obtaining investment advisory services at Julius Baer?

To access our investment advisory services, clients typically start with an initial consultation to discuss their financial goals, risk tolerance, and investment preferences. Our experienced advisors then develop a tailored investment strategy that aligns with these objectives. We provide ongoing monitoring and regular updates to ensure that the investment strategy remains aligned with market conditions and client needs.

Can Julius Baer assist with wealth planning for future generations?

Yes, Julius Baer offers specialized wealth planning services designed to help clients prepare for the financial needs of future generations. Our wealth planning experts work closely with clients to create comprehensive strategies that address inheritance, tax implications, and the transfer of wealth. We emphasize education and engagement with the next generation to ensure a smooth transition and the preservation of family wealth.

What global locations does Julius Baer operate in?

Julius Baer has a significant global presence, with offices in around 60 locations worldwide. Key locations include Zurich (our head office), Hong Kong, London, Dubai, Frankfurt, and Singapore, among others. This extensive network allows us to provide localized expertise and access to global markets, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible service and investment opportunities.

What are structured products, and how can they benefit investors?

Structured products are pre-packaged investment strategies that typically include derivatives and are designed to meet specific investment goals. At Julius Baer, we offer a range of structured products that can provide tailored exposure to various asset classes while managing risk. These products can be beneficial for investors seeking customized solutions that align with their risk appetite and investment horizon, potentially offering enhanced returns compared to traditional investments.

About Leidsa Loto

LEIDSA, short for Lotería Electrónica Internacional Dominicana, is one of the Dominican Republic's leading lottery organizations. Founded in 1997 by Grupo Lina, LEIDSA has transformed the country's lottery landscape with its focus on transparency, public engagement, and accessible prize structures. Since its launch, LEIDSA has been a top choice for lottery enthusiasts due to its consistent payouts and wide range of game offerings.  
  
LEIDSA started as an initiative to bring a structured, electronic-based lottery to the Dominican Republic. As the country’s interest in lotteries grew, LEIDSA's modern approach and reliable prize distribution quickly gained popularity. The lottery is regulated by the Dominican government, ensuring fair play and integrity, with publicized draws and regular audits to maintain transparency. Each draw is supervised by a representative from the Ministry of Finance and a notary public, reinforcing public trust and credibility.  
  
With a large network of authorized sales points, LEIDSA makes it easy for people across the country to participate. This extensive reach has allowed it to build a loyal customer base, contributing to its success over the years.  
  
LEIDSA offers a variety of games that cater to different types of players:  
  
1\. Loto: The flagship game, Loto, is a traditional lottery draw where players select six numbers. The jackpot accumulates until there’s a winner, making it one of the most enticing options.  
  
2\. Loto Más: For an additional fee, players can opt for Loto Más, which offers a higher jackpot, adding an extra layer of excitement.  
  
3\. Loto Pool: This game allows players to select a set of four numbers, providing a simpler, faster option with increased odds of winning smaller prizes.  
  
4\. Super Kino TV: This game offers frequent, lower-stakes opportunities to win. Drawn multiple times daily, it’s popular for players who prefer frequent, smaller wins.  
  
  
  
In recent years, LEIDSA has also introduced holiday jackpots and special promotions, further engaging players and enhancing its appeal. Smaller prizes can be claimed at authorized retailers, while larger prizes are processed directly through LEIDSA’s headquarters.  
  
LEIDSA's influence extends beyond entertainment. A portion of its revenue goes toward healthcare, education, and other community support initiatives. This commitment to social responsibility underscores LEIDSA's role as more than just a lottery provider but as a contributor to the nation's well-being.  
  
The organization also creates jobs through its extensive network of sales agents and operational staff. The economic impact is substantial, with millions of dollars injected annually into the Dominican economy.  
  
LEIDSA’s commitment to transparency has been key to its success. Each draw is broadcast live, and regular audits ensure fairness, giving the public confidence in the lottery’s integrity. LEIDSA has developed a positive reputation, distinguishing itself from other lottery entities through strict adherence to governmental standards and fair play.  
  
In response to the growing demand for digital accessibility, LEIDSA now offers app-based and online ticket purchases, allowing players to participate from home. This digital expansion has modernized the organization, appealing to younger audiences and providing greater convenience.  
  
For further information, inquiries, or to contact LEIDSA directly, you can reach their official customer support through the following contact details:  
  
\- Phone: (809) 563-1120  
\- Email: [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
  
\- Address: Avenida John F. Kennedy, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic  
  
These contact points provide easy access to LEIDSA's customer support for prize claims, game details, and other services. Whether you're a regular player or new to the games, LEIDSA offers a trusted and transparent lottery experience in the Dominican Republic.  
  
LEIDSA has redefined lottery gaming in the Dominican Republic through its wide range of games, commitment to transparency, and positive community impact. With a reliable prize structure and extensive reach, LEIDSA remains a trusted name in the lottery industry, providing entertainment and supporting economic growth. Its continued success reflects its dedication to maintaining a fair, engaging, and accessible gaming experience for the people of the Dominican Republic.

About Space Events
------------------

We always hear people nagging about their job. Sometimes they just want to leave this world and explore another way of life. Music and friends are THE things that people want amongst them during their journey. And then we began to realize: entertainment is one of the most important things in people’s lives. Without it they might go off the deep end. We feel that if you’re able to entertain people, you’re doing a good thing. At night, when the sky is full of stars and the music still gets you the wonderful sensation that you are floating in space, you are here with us. Space Events.  
\-------------------------------------------------------------  
Our services:  
\- Festival  
\- Ski Holidays (Winter)  
\- Artist Management (DJ / Photographer / Video Specialist)  
\- Live Events  
\- Clothing  
\- Event Marketing Consultancy  
\-------------------------------------------------------------  
Welcome Home.  
  
At this moment we are still working on our new project. Creating a brand new website takes a lot of time. We’ve decide to open a new chapter in our history.  
  
We are…  
  
We are the astronauts of the future. We try to give our visitors and believers an unique event experience. We’ve expanded our team, so when you create your own event, you can still have a little bit of SPACE during your event.  
  
We believe…  
  
We believe in our imagination. An event has two sides. A physical experience and an emotional rollercoaster. We trust on our team to combine these two deciding factor, to let people believen in their imagination.  
  
Why?  
  
We transform an ordinary event into an extraordinary happening. We want to see that our visitors feel connected to the organization. We help our guests to escape into space, to discover their new form of happiness amongst the stars.

About CountryMark

CountryMark is an American-owned oil exploration, production, refining and marketing company. The company's complete line of premium quality liquid fuels begins with light, sweet crude oil, which is refined to the highest specifications at the CountryMark refinery in Mt. Vernon, Indiana. Fuel quality is protected as it travels north along a 238-mile private pipeline. State-of-the-art blending technology at each CountryMark fuel terminal ensures that biodiesel and ethanol blended fuels are formulated for optimal driving performance and winter operability.  
  
CountryMark also carries Advantage Lubricants, a complete line of high quality, proprietary lubricant products. CountryMark is a distributor of API-certified TerraCair Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF).  
  
CountryMark fuels, lubricants and DEF are delivered daily to farms, fleets and families across the Midwest, and are available at more than 100 convenient CountryMark-branded fueling stations. More than 65% of farmers and 60% of school corporations in the CountryMark trade area are powered by CountryMark fuels.  
  
CountryMark’s upstream business includes an impressive team of petroleum exploration professionals, geologists, production engineers, drilling specialists and reservoir managers. CountryMark’s oil exploration and production group manage 1,400 oil wells in six states producing 2,500 barrels of oil per day.  
  
Based on 2019 revenues, CountryMark was ranked as the 10th largest private company with headquarters in Indiana. CountryMark has been a farmer-owned cooperative since 1919.

Born and raised in New York City, Julia was exposed to the world of fashion from a young age. Her parents, both Holocaust survivors, taught her the importance of perseverance and determination, values that would shape her career in the years to come. After completing her studies in business and marketing, Julia set out to make her mark in the fashion world.  
  
In 1995, Julia founded her eponymous fashion label, showcasing her debut collection on the runways of New York Fashion Week. From the very beginning, her designs stood out for their meticulous attention to detail, impeccable craftsmanship, and luxurious fabrics. It was clear that Julia had a unique aesthetic that blended sophistication with a touch of rebellion.  
  
Over the years, Julia's label gained a loyal following of fashion-forward clientele, including A-list celebrities and influential tastemakers. Her designs have graced countless red carpets and magazine covers, earning her a reputation as a go-to designer for those seeking something truly extraordinary. In addition to her success as a fashion designer, Julia's entrepreneurial spirit has led her to expand her empire beyond the runway. Julia's keen eye for talent and her ability to identify rising stars has been instrumental in establishing Elite World Group as a global force to be reckoned with.  
  
However, it is Julia's recent venture that has truly made waves in the fashion industry. In 2016, she became the CEO of La Perla, an iconic Italian luxury lingerie brand. Recognizing the brand's untapped potential, Julia set out to reinvent La Perla for the modern woman, injecting it with a new sense of empowerment and sex appeal. Under her leadership, the brand expanded its offerings to include ready-to-wear collections, accessories, and even a men's line, solidifying its position as a lifestyle brand.  
  
Julia's transformative approach to fashion has not only revitalized the brand but also challenged societal norms and outdated beauty standards. She believes that every woman deserves to feel confident and beautiful, regardless of her size or shape. This commitment to inclusivity and body positivity has resonated with consumers worldwide, earning La Perla a devoted following and solidifying its status as a trailblazer in the industry.  
  
Beyond her fashion endeavors, Julia is also a devoted philanthropist, using her success to make a positive impact in the world. She is actively involved in charities that support causes such as education, women's empowerment, and humanitarian aid. Julia's dedication to giving back is a testament to her strong belief in the importance of using one's influence and resources to create meaningful change.  
  
In conclusion, Julia Haart is a force to be reckoned with in the world of fashion and entrepreneurship. What services does Adeptus Health offer at its freestanding emergency rooms?

Adeptus Health provides a wide range of emergency medical services at its freestanding emergency rooms, including treatment for acute illnesses and injuries, diagnostic imaging, laboratory services, and minor surgical procedures. Our facilities are equipped to handle emergencies such as fractures, severe abdominal pain, respiratory issues, and more, ensuring that patients receive high-quality care in a comfortable environment.

How does Adeptus Health ensure quality patient care?

Adeptus Health is committed to delivering patient-centered care through a combination of highly trained medical professionals, state-of-the-art facilities, and adherence to best practices in emergency medicine. We continuously monitor patient outcomes and satisfaction to improve our services. Our partnerships with premier healthcare providers also enhance the quality of care we offer, ensuring that patients receive comprehensive treatment and follow-up as needed.

Are Adeptus Health's freestanding emergency rooms open 24/7?

Yes, all Adeptus Health freestanding emergency rooms are open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. This ensures that patients have access to emergency medical care whenever they need it, without the long wait times often associated with traditional hospital emergency departments.

What types of insurance does Adeptus Health accept?

Adeptus Health accepts a variety of insurance plans, including major commercial insurance providers, Medicare, and Medicaid. We recommend that patients contact their local Adeptus Health facility or visit our website to verify specific coverage details and ensure that their insurance plan is accepted.

Can I receive follow-up care after my visit to an Adeptus Health facility?

Yes, Adeptus Health is dedicated to providing continuity of care. After your visit, our medical team will provide you with a detailed discharge plan, including any necessary follow-up appointments or referrals to specialists. We also offer assistance in coordinating care with your primary healthcare provider to ensure a seamless transition and ongoing support.

What should I do in case of a medical emergency?

In the event of a medical emergency, you should seek immediate care. If you are near an Adeptus Health freestanding emergency room, you can go directly to the facility for evaluation and treatment. If you are unable to transport yourself, call 911 for assistance. Remember, it's always better to err on the side of caution when it comes to your health.

About WastePlan - Waste Management and Recycling Services
---------------------------------------------------------

WastePlan is a leading provider of on-site waste management and recycling services in South Africa, dedicated to reducing waste sent to landfills. Headquartered in Queensburgh, Durban, KwaZulu Natal, WastePlan boasts a national footprint, offering tailored solutions to a diverse range of industries, including residential, commercial, retail, and industrial sectors. With a commitment to sustainability, WastePlan currently manages residential recycling collections in select areas of Cape Town and serves over 600 clients across the country, ensuring efficient waste disposal and recycling practices.  
  
The company’s comprehensive suite of services includes waste audits, recycling collections, and the implementation of waste management strategies designed to minimize environmental impact. WastePlan employs innovative technologies and best practices to enhance waste segregation and recycling processes, making it easier for clients to adhere to environmental regulations and corporate sustainability goals. By leveraging advanced tracking and reporting systems, WastePlan provides clients with valuable insights into their waste generation patterns, enabling them to make informed decisions about waste reduction.  
  
As a trusted partner in waste management, WastePlan is committed to educating clients and communities about the importance of recycling and responsible waste disposal. Their proactive approach not only supports businesses in achieving their sustainability objectives but also contributes to the broader goal of creating a cleaner, greener future for South Africa. For more information about WastePlan's services and initiatives, visit their website at www.wasteplan.co.za.

How does Miami Ad School prepare students for careers in advertising and marketing?

Miami Ad School prepares students for careers in advertising and marketing through a hands-on, project-based curriculum that emphasizes real-world experience. What is the duration of the programs at Miami Ad School?

The duration of programs at Miami Ad School varies depending on the specific course of study. Are there any prerequisites for enrolling in Miami Ad School?

While there are no strict prerequisites for enrolling in Miami Ad School, applicants are generally expected to have a high school diploma or equivalent. Some programs may require a portfolio showcasing creative work, especially for fields like copywriting, art direction, and digital design. Prospective students are encouraged to review specific program requirements and reach out to admissions for guidance.

What kind of support does Miami Ad School provide to students during their studies?

Miami Ad School offers a range of support services to help students succeed during their studies. This includes personalized mentorship from experienced faculty, access to career services for job placement assistance, portfolio reviews, and workshops on industry trends. Additionally, students can benefit from a vibrant community of peers and alumni who provide networking opportunities and collaborative projects.

Can international students apply to Miami Ad School?

Yes, Miami Ad School welcomes international students and offers programs that cater to a diverse student body. International applicants must meet specific admission requirements, including proof of English proficiency and visa eligibility. The school provides guidance throughout the application process and offers resources to help international students acclimate to life in Miami and succeed in their studies.

Tampa Bay is also home to the 2002 Super Bowl Champions Tampa Bay Buccaneers, 2004 Stanley Cup Champions Tampa Bay Lightning, perennial Arena Bowl winner Tampa Storm, Tampa Mutiny of MLS and borders the Orlando Magic market.  
  
The University of South Florida is the fourth largest college in Florida with about 50,000 students and Tampa is also home to the University of Tampa, while St. Petersburg has St. Petersburg College and Eckerd University.

Connect every American, every door, every business, everywhere through the simple act of delivering mail and packages. This idea of universal service is at the heart of the $1.4 trillion industry that employs more than 7.5 million people and drives commerce, plays an integral part in every American community and remains the greatest value of any post in the world.

About National Diversity Council
--------------------------------

HISTORY  
The National Diversity Council is a non-profit 501 (C)(3) organization that champions diversity as a business imperative. The National Diversity Council was launched in the summer of 2008. The catalyst for the National Diversity Council was the need for a national organization that would champion diversity and inclusion across the country and also the success of the Texas Diversity Council (TXDC) established in 2004.  
  
VISION  
The vision of the NDC is to cultivate a nationwide network of affiliated councils to advance diversity and inclusion by transforming our workplaces and communities into inclusive environments where individuals are valued for their talents and empowered to reach their fullest potential.  
  
MISSION  
The mission of the NDC is to be both a resource and an advocate for the value of diversity and inclusion. The NDC serves as the umbrella organization to support our statewide and regional affiliates, which foster an understanding of diversity and inclusion as a dynamic strategy for business success and community well-being through various initiatives.

About Jo Tankers
----------------

Jo Tankers is a leading provider of deep-sea transportation services for chemicals and other high value liquids like petroleum products and edible oils.  
  
We are responsible for technical and commercial management of a fleet varying in size up to 74.500 dwt. Some vessels in our fleet can also carry semi-gas type products like propylene oxide and butadiene. Each vessel has up to 40 fully segregated cargo tanks, the majority of which are constructed from stainless steel.  
  
Our company has pioneered a number of innovations starting with the introduction of the first tanker with stainless cargo tanks back in 1960 and by introducing the first large double hull chemical parcel tanker in 1993.  
  
  
We will also in the future continue to strive for better and more advanced ships and systems in order for further improvement of quality, safety and efficiency of our operations.  
  
Jo Tankers has freight contracts with many of the world's leading oil and chemical companies, which provide a steady base to our activities. In all market segments in which we operate we provide regular sailings to our customers. Each and every cargo is handled with utmost care. We are continuously improving the quality of our services as well as adapting our organization to the ever-changing market and customer requirements. Our objective is to maintain long-term relationships with customers, as well as with suppliers and financial institutions.  
  
Quality, Safety and Environmental Care are and will remain our top priorities. In our offices world wide as well as on board our vessels we have approximately 780 skilled employees. With secure and stable working conditions both ashore and on board we deliver safe transportation with the highest standards on service and quality.

About Timothy Olyphant

Timothy Olyphant is an American actor known for his versatile and compelling performances across film and television. With his rugged good looks and undeniable charisma, Olyphant has captivated audiences with his ability to seamlessly transition between intense drama and wry humor.  
  
Born on May 20, 1968, in Honolulu, Hawaii, Olyphant developed an early passion for acting. After graduating from the University of Southern California's School of Dramatic Arts, he embarked on his acting career with determination and grit. Olyphant's breakthrough came in 1999 when he portrayed the slick and devious drug dealer, Todd Gaines, in the critically acclaimed indie film "Go." This role showcased his ability to portray complex and morally ambiguous characters, setting the stage for his future success.  
  
In 2004, Olyphant landed the role of a lifetime as Sheriff Seth Bullock in HBO's critically acclaimed series, "Deadwood." His portrayal of the stoic and conflicted lawman garnered widespread acclaim, establishing him as a formidable actor in the television landscape. Olyphant's performance as the cunning and ruthless cyber-terrorist showcased his ability to elevate a character and deliver a memorable performance.

When it comes to Olyphant's craft, his commitment to his characters is unparalleled. Known for immersing himself in his roles, Olyphant goes to great lengths to understand the motivations and complexities of the characters he portrays. This dedication shines through in his performances, as he effortlessly brings depth and nuance to every role he tackles.  
  
Off-screen, Olyphant maintains a down-to-earth persona and values his privacy. Despite being a sought-after actor in Hollywood, he remains grounded and focused on his craft. Olyphant's genuine nature and dedication to his work have made him a respected figure in the industry.  
  
In conclusion, Timothy Olyphant is an American actor whose talent and versatility have earned him critical acclaim and a dedicated fan base. From his breakthrough role in "Go" to his unforgettable performances in "Deadwood," "Justified," and various films, Olyphant continues to impress with his charismatic screen presence and ability to bring complex characters to life. With an unwavering commitment to his craft, Olyphant's range and dedication make him one of the most captivating actors in the industry today.

About George Strait

George Strait is not just a legendary singer and songwriter, he is the embodiment of country music itself. With a career spanning over four decades, Strait has become one of the most influential and successful artists in American music history. Born in Poteet, Texas, on May 18, 1952, he was raised on a ranch and developed a deep appreciation for the simple yet profound stories that define the country way of life.  
  
It was evident from a young age that Strait possessed a remarkable talent. He began playing guitar while attending high school, and his natural ability to captivate an audience quickly became apparent. However, music wasn't always his primary focus. After graduating, Strait enlisted in the United States Army and served for four years. While stationed in Hawaii, he formed a band called "Rambling Country," which allowed him to further hone his musical skills.  
  
Following his military service, Strait returned to Texas and pursued his dream of becoming a professional musician. He played local bars and honky-tonks, gradually building a fanbase and gaining recognition for his smooth voice and traditional sound. In 1981, his hard work and dedication paid off when he signed a record deal with MCA Records and released his debut album, "Strait Country."  
  
The album struck a chord with country music enthusiasts and established Strait as an artist who respected and honored the genre's roots. It featured the hit single "Unwound," which immediately resonated with fans and shot up the charts. This was just the beginning of Strait's unparalleled success. Throughout the 1980s, he released a string of critically acclaimed albums that solidified his status as a country music icon.  
  
Strait's signature style can best be described as traditional country with a contemporary twist. His smooth, rich baritone voice effortlessly delivers heartfelt lyrics, transporting listeners to another time and place. His ability to connect with the audience on a personal level is unmatched, and his songs explore themes of love, heartbreak, family, and the joys and struggles of everyday life. Strait's commitment to authenticity has earned him respect from both critics and fans, ensuring his place in the annals of country music history.  
  
With over 60 No. 1 hits to his name, Strait has surpassed all other artists in the country genre. His chart-topping success includes iconic songs such as "Amarillo by Morning," "All My Ex's Live in Texas," "Ocean Front Property," and "The Chair." These timeless classics have become anthems for country music lovers and continue to be cherished by generations of fans.  
  
What sets Strait apart from his contemporaries is his unwavering commitment to his music and humble nature. Despite achieving unprecedented levels of success, he has remained rooted in his humble beginnings and continues to approach his craft with humility and sincerity. Strait's dedication to his fans is evident in his live performances, where he effortlessly commands the stage, delivering unforgettable shows that leave audiences enthralled.  
  
In addition to his remarkable music career, Strait has also dabbled in acting, showcasing his versatility and talent beyond singing and songwriting. He appeared in the film "Pure Country," where his acting skills garnered praise from critics and fans alike. Though his primary focus has always been on his music, his foray into acting only solidified his status as a multi-talented entertainer.  
  
George Strait's impact on the country music genre cannot be overstated. His timeless songs, unwavering integrity, and genuine love for his craft have made him an icon who continues to inspire countless artists. His induction into the Country Music Hall of Fame in 2006 and the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2018 further cemented his status as a living legend.  
  
As Strait gracefully navigates his fifth decade in the industry, he shows no signs of slowing down. He continues to release new music, tour, and share his gift with the world. With every note he sings, he reminds us why he is the undisputed "King of Country Music." George Strait is more than just an American singer and songwriter; he is a living legend whose music resonates with audiences far and wide, and his impact on the country genre will endure for generations to come.

THE VOICE OF CRAFT DISTILLING

### Frequently Asked Questions about American Distilling Institute

Who are the decision makers in American Distilling Institute?

The decision makers in American Distilling Institute are [Annesophie Ribaultwhitehead](https://contactout.com/Anne-Sophie-Whitehead-2666930)
, Bill Owens, Eric Zandona, etc. Click to Find [American Distilling Institute decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=American%20Distilling%20Institute&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What types of services does the American Distilling Institute offer to craft distillers?

The American Distilling Institute (ADI) provides a variety of services tailored to the needs of craft distillers. These include educational resources such as hands-on classes that cover distillation techniques, regulatory compliance, and business management. Additionally, ADI hosts the annual Spirits Conference & Vendor Expo, which offers networking opportunities, industry insights, and access to suppliers. The ADI Spirits Competition is another key service, allowing distillers to showcase their products and gain recognition in the industry.

How can I participate in the ADI Spirits Competition?

To participate in the ADI Spirits Competition, distillers must submit their spirits for evaluation by a panel of experienced judges. The competition typically opens for entries several months before the annual Spirits Conference. Distillers can find detailed information about submission guidelines, entry fees, and deadlines on the ADI website. Winning awards in this competition can significantly enhance a distillery's visibility and credibility in the market.

What educational opportunities does ADI provide for new distillers?

ADI offers a range of educational opportunities for new distillers, including hands-on classes that cover essential topics such as fermentation, distillation, aging, and bottling. These classes are designed to provide practical knowledge and skills necessary for operating a successful distillery. Additionally, ADI hosts webinars and workshops that focus on industry trends, marketing strategies, and regulatory compliance, ensuring that new distillers are well-equipped to navigate the challenges of the craft distilling industry.

What industries does the American Distilling Institute support?

The American Distilling Institute primarily supports the craft distilling industry, which includes small-batch, independently-owned distilleries producing spirits such as whiskey, gin, vodka, rum, and more. ADI also engages with related industries, including agriculture (for sourcing raw materials), hospitality (for bars and restaurants serving craft spirits), and retail (for liquor stores and distributors). By fostering collaboration among these sectors, ADI aims to promote the growth and sustainability of craft distilling as a whole.

How can I become a member of the American Distilling Institute?

To become a member of the American Distilling Institute, individuals or businesses can visit the ADI website and complete the membership application process. Membership options are available for distillers, suppliers, and industry supporters, each with specific benefits such as access to exclusive resources, discounts on events, and networking opportunities. Membership is open to anyone involved in the craft distilling industry, and joining ADI provides valuable support and advocacy for the sector.

What resources does ADI provide for regulatory compliance in distilling?

The American Distilling Institute offers various resources to help distillers navigate regulatory compliance. These include educational materials, guidelines on federal and state regulations, and access to industry experts who can provide advice on compliance issues. ADI also advocates for the interests of craft distillers at the legislative level, working to ensure that regulations are fair and supportive of small-batch producers. Members can benefit from workshops and seminars focused on compliance topics, helping them stay informed and compliant with the law.

Smart's versatility on both ends of the court has made him a key player in the Celtics' success.

Smart believes in giving back and inspiring the next generation, using his platform to make a positive impact beyond the basketball court.  
  
In conclusion, Marcus Smart is a highly skilled and impactful basketball player known for his intense defense, versatility, and leadership. The Northeast’s premier resort destination for fun, excitement and ultimate relaxation, Turning Stone Resort Casino is conveniently located about 30 miles east of Syracuse at NYS Thruway Exit 33. Turning Stone also is home to three acclaimed award-winning championship golf courses, two outstanding nine-hole courses and unrivaled indoor practice facilities.  
  
Two full-service spas, the award-winning Skana Spa and Ahsi Day Spa & Salon offer treatments and services to revitalize the body and spirit.  
  
Turning Stone is one of a select few resorts in America to feature two AAA Four Diamond hotels – The Lodge, our all-suite hotel and The Tower which rises 21 stories over central New York. We also offer classic lodging at The Hotel and more moderately priced rooms at The Inn.  
  
With over 21 dining choices you are sure to find something to satisfy your appetite – from fine dining and authentic Asian fare, to Italian cuisine and the finest choice beef and seafood.  
  
The Casino features 24/7 gaming action, including 99 table games and 2,000 of the latest slot machines offering jackpots into the millions of dollars, and a live poker room and high-stakes bingo.  
  
Headline entertainers bring excitement to the Showroom and Event Center entertainment venues. Guests can dance the night away with live music and DJs at multiple clubs in the Exit 33 entertainment complex. With something for everyone, the Tin Rooster is a country dance hall and BBQ joint, The Gig is the home to live rock and roll, the Turquoise Tiger is a sophisticated lounge and cocktail bar and Lava is an incredible night club experience.

About Magnetic Insight, Inc
---------------------------

Magnetic Insight introduces magnetic particle imaging, a groundbreaking imaging technology addressing today's clinical and translational research challenges.  
  
Magnetic Particle Imaging (MPI) is a new imaging technology unique from any other technology on the market. It is a functional imaging modality similar to PET, SPECT and optical where real time biological events can be monitored verses anatomical imaging such as computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). MPI offers the ability to target biomarkers, introduced into the cell and as a vascular tracer to support real-time blood flow and vascular architecture all with direct quantitation. Harnessing the magnetic properties of iron oxide nanoparticles, visualization and quantitation is specific, direct and unobstructed by tissue depth at exquisite sensitivity and with elegant resolution.

About Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco
-------------------------------------------

We are the San Francisco Fed, public servants with a congressionally mandated mission to promote a healthy and sustainable economy and support the nation’s financial and payment systems. With offices in Los Angeles, Seattle, Salt Lake City, and Portland, as well as cash processing in Phoenix, we are the Twelfth Federal Reserve District. We serve one fifth of the nation’s population—the largest and most diverse of the twelve Federal Reserve Districts within the Federal Reserve System.  
  
As part of the nation’s central bank, we inform monetary policy, regulate banks, administer certain consumer protection laws, and act as a financial partner to the U.S. government. We listen, learn, and reflect the communities we serve so we can make better decisions and policy to help our nation thrive.  
  
We also have unique responsibilities and areas of expertise within the Federal Reserve System. For example, the San Francisco Fed is the headquarters for the Federal Reserve’s Cash Product Office, which oversees and supports the entire System’s cash distribution process. With global technology hubs in our District, our Fintech team facilitates innovation that is designed to improve market efficiency, yield public benefits, and promote people and businesses’ fair, informed, and transparent access to financial services. As part of our commitment to understanding how current and future risks affect our dual mandate goals, our Sustainable Growth team in Economic Research focuses their research on assessing the economic effects of a changing climate.  
  
Unreserved opportunity is the touchstone that guides our work. We believe opportunity is not a luxury—it is a necessity and needs to be accessible to everyone. By achieving our dual mandate of maximum employment and price stability, we see ourselves as opportunity builders, helping our economy and every American reach their full potential.

The great late night news gains are also pushing other Cleveland 19 Newscasts on WOIO: Cleveland 19 News This Morning and Cleveland 19 News at Noon are all trending upward. And with the addition of Cleveland 19 News at 4 p.m. to the already established 5 p.m. and 6 p.m. newscasts, Clevelanders have plenty of opportunities to watch a news operation clearly on the move.  
  
Through its affiliation with CBS, WOIO is home to NCAA College Football, NCAA College Basketball including the "March Madness" Basketball Tournament, several premiere golf events including The Masters, and Tennis' U.S. Open.  
  
WOIO's Sign-On Date was May 19, 1985. In 1986, Malrite Communications Group gained majority ownership of the station, which it maintained until September 1998 when Raycom Media purchased the station.

About Rachel Robinson

Rachel Mack Robinson, as the Founder of Huddle Up (formerly DotCom Therapy), is at the forefront of transforming the landscape of therapy delivery through innovative health tech solutions. Under her leadership, Huddle Up has successfully linked expert therapists with clients, ensuring that quality speech therapy, occupational therapy, and mental health services are just a click away, regardless of geographical barriers.  
  
Rachel's expertise spans a wide range of areas, including Autism Spectrum Disorders, Early Intervention, and Learning Disabilities, making her a pivotal figure in the development of tailored therapeutic approaches. Her commitment to building a sustainable culture of providers is reflected in the company's mission to provide therapy services to everyone, everywhere. Key projects under her guidance include the implementation of user-friendly platforms that enhance the client experience while streamlining clinician workflows, thereby addressing the unique challenges faced by both parties in traditional therapy settings.  
  
In addition to her entrepreneurial endeavors, Rachel is a staunch advocate for the integration of technology in rehabilitation and treatment, believing that innovative solutions can bridge the gap in healthcare accessibility. Her vision for Huddle Up is not only to redefine therapy delivery but also to foster a community where providers are empowered and clients receive the support they need to thrive. Through her leadership, Rachel is setting new standards in the health tech industry, ensuring that therapy is accessible, effective, and tailored to meet the diverse needs of individuals across the spectrum of care.

Born on March 11, 1983, in New York City, Lucy DeVito is the daughter of Hollywood legends Danny DeVito and Rhea Perlman. Inspired by her parents' success and passion for their craft, she developed a deep love for the performing arts, embarking on a journey to become an actress herself.

About United States Olympic Committee
-------------------------------------

At the United States Olympic & Paralympic Committee, our mission is to empower Team USA athletes to achieve sustained competitive excellence and well-being.  
We do this with a commitment to our core principles:  
  
\- We promote and protect athletes’ rights, safety and wellness.  
\- We champion the integrity of sport.  
\- We respect the important role of our member organizations and support their need for success.  
\- We set clear standards of organizational excellence and hold ourselves and all member organizations accountable.  
\- We engage as a trusted and influential leader to advance the global Olympic and Paralympic movements.  
\- We honor and celebrate the legacy of Olympic and Paralympic athletes.  
  
A federally-chartered nonprofit, the USOPC oversees both Olympic and Paralympic sport in the country – one of less than five National Olympic Committees to do so. Through a commitment to supporting and empowering America’s athletes, the USOPC is driven to bring the very best of the United States of America to the world through sport.

About JC Industries
-------------------

JC Industries has continuously provided service to the garment industry with our "Made in the USA" products for over 40 years. We're a full-package, private-label garment manufacturer for Harley Davison, North face, Carhart and many other household names! JC Industries also offers our own lines of custom apparel including:  
\- HexiFlex USA  
\- Launj Aut  
\- Lucky Soul; and,  
\- HFC (Hunting Fishing Camping).  
  
JC Industries is vertically integrated, enabling us to provide 100% of design, development and production within our 75,000SF facility in Montebello, CA. The JC Industries in-house design team provides services including product design & development, cut & sew, tech, graphics, silk screen, and embellishments to name a few. We can handle all aspects of production from concept to completion. JC Industries manufactures domestic “Made in the USA” products in addition to full-service import programs.  
  
Keeping with a true "Made in the USA" platform, our sourced cotton is grown, cleaned, spun and dyed in North Carolina then shipped to our WRAP certified facility in Los Angeles for production. JC Industries also uses eco-friendly processes, which are 95% percent chemical free, thus reducing our carbon footprint in the environment. We are fully compliant with ALL California manufacturing regulations which are by far the strictest in all of the United States.  
  
WRAP COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATION  
The Worldwide Responsible Accredited Production (WRAP) program is the world's largest facility-based social and environmental certification program, mainly focused on apparel, footwear and sewn products sectors. WRAP Certification ensures factories produce goods under lawful, humane and ethical conditions. WRAP monitors the factory for compliance with detailed practices and procedures implied by adherence to these standards.  
  
OUR LINES

About Salm Partners, LLC
------------------------

Salm Partners is a contract manufacturer of fully cooked, premium sausage and hot dog products. The company was founded in 2004 by four brothers, Joe, Pete, Chris and Mark Salm. They pooled their individual talents together to create our organization, using the “partnership” concept as the cornerstone for success.  
  
The Salm brothers had the foresight to invest in innovative manufacturing technology that set it apart in the meat industry. This technology is based on two processes: co-extrusion, and cook-in-package. The end result is sausage that is superior in taste and quality, and superior from a food safety standpoint as well. The products Salm produces have changed the marketplace for the better. The company continues to seek out new technologies in the food industry that have the same market-changing potential.  
  
We broke ground here in Denmark in July of 2004, building the facility from the ground up. Our first dinner sausage product hit the production line in March 2005, and we have been going – and growing – ever since. Our current workforce is nearly 450 partners, with 4 lines of production in operation around-the-clock. We have also extended our capabilities to include onsite blending & formulation of product.  
  
To see our unique production process, click on the link to our website (www.salmpartners.com) and view the brief video of Salm Partners in action. We think you’ll like what you see!

About CDC Small Business Finance
--------------------------------

We are an award-winning small business lender that steps up for entrepreneurs when traditional lenders can’t or won’t. Over the last 44 years, we’ve provided more than $20 billion in low-cost business loans to over 11,000 borrower clients... and counting.  
  
Unlike a traditional bank, we have the flexibility to offer affordable loans to a broader pool of small business owners looking to finance building purchases, major equipment, and working capital, among other purposes.  
  
As a nonprofit and community lender, CDC Small Business Finance's No. 1 mission is to help those who face the greatest obstacles in securing capital including women, minority and veteran-owned businesses. To do that, we don’t fixate on just hard numbers, we consider your entire entrepreneurial story. We believe if you invest in an entrepreneur, you also invest in their community.  
  
As one of the leading SBA 504 lenders in the U.S., CDC Small Business Finance offers fixed-rate, long-term loans for commercial real estate and major equipment. This low-cost option not only makes financial sense for entrepreneurs, it’s also proven to be an effective economic development driver. Our SBA 504 loan fundings have led to over 244,000 jobs created or preserved in California, Arizona and Nevada.  
  
We’ve been the No. 1 SBA Community Advantage lender in the nation several years in a row. Through this program, new and existing business owners can borrow up to $250,000 in low-cost business capital. To cover a wider spectrum of needs, we also offer alternative non-SBA products.  
  
As your lending advocate, you can expect personalized care, attention to detail and sound advice before, during and after funding -- in every single deal.  
  
Specialties: Commercial Real Estate Financing, SBA 504 Loan, SBA 7(a) Loans, SBA Community Advantage, SBA Microloan, CDFI, Equipment financing, Land financing, Working Capital, Business Advising, Business Coaching.

What types of loans does CDC Small Business Finance offer?

CDC Small Business Finance offers a variety of loan products tailored to meet the needs of small businesses. Our offerings include SBA 7(a) loans for working capital and business expansion, SBA 504 loans for purchasing commercial real estate and equipment, microloans for startups and small businesses, and equipment financing to help businesses acquire necessary machinery. We also provide specialized financing solutions for land purchases and working capital needs.

How does CDC Small Business Finance support entrepreneurs who may not qualify for traditional loans?

At CDC Small Business Finance, we understand that many entrepreneurs face challenges when seeking financing from traditional lenders. Our mission is to step up for these individuals by offering flexible loan options, personalized support, and business coaching. We work closely with our clients to assess their unique situations and provide tailored financing solutions that align with their business goals, even if they have less-than-perfect credit or limited financial history.

What is the process for applying for a loan with CDC Small Business Finance?

The application process for a loan with CDC Small Business Finance is straightforward. First, you can start by filling out our online application form or contacting one of our loan officers for assistance. After submitting your application, our team will review your financial information and business plan. We may request additional documentation to better understand your needs. Once approved, we will work with you to finalize the loan terms and disburse the funds to support your business.

Does CDC Small Business Finance offer business coaching or advising services?

Yes, CDC Small Business Finance provides business coaching and advising services to help entrepreneurs navigate the complexities of running a small business. Our experienced advisors offer guidance on various topics, including financial management, marketing strategies, and operational efficiency. We believe that providing support beyond financing is crucial for the long-term success of our clients, and we are committed to helping them achieve their business objectives.

What industries does CDC Small Business Finance serve?

CDC Small Business Finance serves a wide range of industries, including retail, hospitality, healthcare, manufacturing, and professional services, among others. Our diverse portfolio allows us to understand the unique challenges faced by businesses in different sectors and provide tailored financing solutions that meet their specific needs. Whether you are a startup or an established business looking to expand, we are here to support you.

Are there any educational resources available for small business owners through CDC Small Business Finance?

Yes, CDC Small Business Finance offers a variety of educational resources designed to empower small business owners. Our resources include articles, webinars, and workshops that cover essential topics such as credit repair, financial planning, and effective business strategies.
