Michelle Nunn, as President and CEO of CARE USA, has been a transformative leader in the nonprofit sector, steering the organization towards unprecedented growth and impact. Under her guidance, CARE has expanded its reach to over 167 million people in 2023, a testament to her strategic vision and commitment to social justice. With a robust team of more than 8,000 professionals operating in over 100 countries, Nunn has successfully implemented innovative programs that address the root causes of poverty, empower women and girls, and promote sustainable development.  
  
One of her key initiatives has been the deployment of a bold strategic framework aimed at scaling CARE's impact to 200 million lives by 2020. This ambitious goal has not only enhanced the organization's fundraising capabilities but also strengthened its program management and operational efficiency. Nunn’s expertise in philanthropy and public speaking has been instrumental in forging partnerships with governments, corporations, and other nonprofits, amplifying CARE's voice on global platforms.  
  
In addition to her strategic acumen, Nunn is deeply committed to research and data-driven decision-making, ensuring that CARE’s programs are both effective and sustainable. Her leadership style fosters collaboration and innovation, empowering her team to tackle complex challenges in the humanitarian sector. As a passionate advocate for social change, Michelle Nunn continues to inspire others in the nonprofit landscape, demonstrating that with the right strategy and leadership, it is possible to create lasting change and uplift communities around the world.

About The Minority Freedom Community Fund
-----------------------------------------

The Minority Freedom Community Fund (‘the Fund’) is a public foundation organized to improve the lives of minorities through a multifaceted approach that includes providing capital infusions, supporting existing social infrastructure, and promoting holistic wellness. It was established by philanthropist TeQuion Brookins in 2019 to address severe unmet need among minorities in the United States. The goal of the fund is to elevate participatory grantmaking among those who are most often the targets but rarely the voices of traditional philanthropy. Addressing the economical, social, and spiritual well-being of minorities across the country is done through a variety of programs that are led by community members, civic leaders, other nonprofits, business owners, and government agencies alike. Our delivery method primarily entails serving as a fiduciary for programs and providing grants, interest-free loans, and technical assistance to individuals and businesses that align with our mission.  
  
As a community fund, or goal is to ensure that the people we aim to serve have the loudest voices in our decision-making processes. We choose to:  
  
1\. Prioritize funding requests from those who have been turned away from other programs, are ineligible for existing supports, or need additional help to fill the gaps other sources have created through insufficient support;  
  
2\. Minimize barriers for our recipients and our donors through simplified, virtual application & awarding processes and robust, comprehensive donation acceptance procedures; and  
  
3\. Dedicate our resources to core, mission-aligned activities by operating 100% remotely to minimize overhead costs associated with running a national program and expand our reach.

As the CEO and Chief Voice at Voice Craft, Roger Kibbe is at the forefront of revolutionizing how individuals and businesses interact with technology through voice. His strategic vision is complemented by a robust understanding of blockchain and Web3 technologies, positioning Voice Craft as a pioneer in integrating these cutting-edge solutions into voice-driven experiences.  
  
Under Roger's leadership, Voice Craft is currently spearheading several key projects aimed at enhancing user engagement and streamlining everyday interactions through voice technology. These initiatives not only focus on creating intuitive voice applications but also emphasize voice education, empowering users and organizations to harness the full potential of voice interfaces. Roger's commitment to agile methodologies ensures that the development process is both efficient and adaptable, allowing for rapid iteration and deployment of solutions that meet the evolving needs of clients.  
  
With a comprehensive skill set that includes business analysis, solution architecture, and machine learning, Roger is adept at navigating the complexities of the software development life cycle (SDLC). His strategic leadership fosters a culture of innovation within the company, encouraging collaboration and creativity among team members. As Voice Craft continues to push the boundaries of voice technology, Roger Kibbe remains a driving force in shaping the future of human-computer interaction, making everyday experiences more seamless and engaging through the power of AI.

Alberta Pensions Services Corporation (APS) guides the pension experience on behalf of Alberta's public sector pension plans by providing administrative services to more than 500 participating employers across Alberta.

We manage over $6.3 billion in pension plan funds annually through receipts and disbursements to and from employers, members and other pension plans.

Tufts University School of Medicine, located at 136 Harrison Avenue in Boston, Massachusetts, is a prestigious institution dedicated to cultivating the next generation of healthcare leaders. With a commitment to excellence in medical education, Tufts offers three distinct educational pathways: the Doctor of Medicine (MD) program, professional degrees such as the Master of Science in Biomedical Sciences, Doctor of Physical Therapy, and Physician Assistant programs, as well as advanced degrees in public health and health informatics & analytics through its Public Health Programs.  
  
Students in the MD program benefit from a robust curriculum that combines classroom learning with hands-on clinical experiences in a variety of esteemed healthcare settings across Boston, Maine, and western Massachusetts. This immersive approach not only equips students with essential medical knowledge but also fosters critical thinking and compassionate patient care. The faculty at Tufts University School of Medicine is composed of distinguished educators and practitioners who are dedicated to mentoring students and advancing the field of medicine. For those interested in the academic credentials and expertise of the faculty, a comprehensive Tufts University School of Medicine teachers list is available on the school's website, showcasing the diverse backgrounds and specialties of the instructors.  
  
Overall, Tufts University School of Medicine stands out for its innovative programs, commitment to community health, and emphasis on interdisciplinary collaboration, making it a top choice for aspiring healthcare professionals seeking a comprehensive and dynamic educational experience.

About Orca Maritime, Inc.
-------------------------

Orca Maritime, Inc. is an underwater services company established by two retired U.S. Navy Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) experts with extensive experience in military EOD and salvage diving, underwater mine countermeasures, unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) and remotely operated vehicle (ROV) operations.  
  
Applying over 50 years of experience in underwater EOD, mine countermeasures and diving, and using U.S. Navy-vetted underwater security techniques and procedures, Orca Maritime provides a comprehensive set of products and services, including high resolution side-scan sonar and bathymetric imagery, magnetic anomaly localization, underwater video and photography, environmental data collection, channel conditioning, pipeline localization and underwater Geographic Information System (GIS) components to industry and government customers. Orca Maritime’s undersea systems technicians and divers are highly experienced, and fully qualified.  
  
As an underwater service provider in San Diego’s BlueTech economy, Orca Maritime has established itself as the leader in the employment of cutting edge underwater sensor technology through the use of advanced man-portable underwater survey equipment in support of commercial enterprise, law enforcement and militaries around the world. Orca Maritime provides professional consulting in all aspects of underwater operations in port, harbor and coastal environments. With significant operational expertise in underwater security, mapping and GIS, underwater maintenance and diving, Orca Maritime has a unique perspective on response plans, visualization tools and optimizing technologically advanced underwater equipment and resources to support underwater infrastructure inspection and repair, emergency action plans for port security organizations, engineering maintenance programs, environmental monitoring initiatives and underwater unexploded ordnance remediation efforts.

Bruce Butler is a dynamic Building Designer at JB Hammer Designs, where he leverages his extensive expertise in residential design to transform client visions into tangible architectural realities. At JB Hammer Designs, Bruce is involved in a diverse range of projects, from custom homes to remodel plans and stock house designs. Key projects under Bruce's direction have included innovative home additions that seamlessly blend with existing structures, as well as comprehensive renovations that breathe new life into older homes. His ability to render detailed visualizations allows clients to experience their spaces in a realistic context, fostering confidence in their design choices. About Misha Nonoo (Official)

OUR MISSION  
We are a brand made by and for women, committed to enhancing the full lives of our dynamic clients with innovative products and services that promote sustainability and longevity, create a sense of effortlessness and freedom within a hectic world, and encourage meaningful personal connections. We are a small business trying to revolutionize an industry and every one of us contributes meaningfully to our goal of positive change.  
  
ABOUT MISHA NONOO  
Born in Bahrain, raised in London, and educated in Paris, Misha Nonoo’s multicultural upbringing exposed her to a diverse collection of references. Her work showcases a unique outlook for the modern multifaceted woman. Offering versatile pieces at accessible price points, her collection is progressive yet classic, with both smart and playful details that support women from 9am to 9pm.  
  
Misha won industry recognition when she became a finalist for the 2013 CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund and was named one of Forbes’ 30 under 30 as well as Crain’s New York Business’s 40 under 40.  
  
Since the launch of Misha Nonoo, the label has cultivated a loyal following that includes Meghan Markle, Emma Watson, Amal Clooney, Gwyneth Paltrow, and Cate Blanchett, to name a few.  
  
Misha pioneered the use of social media as a “venue” for fashion shows, exclusively debuting her Spring/Summer 2016 collection on Instagram, an innovative project for which she won the Fashion Futures Award for Best Beyond-the-Runway Experience, and her Fall 2016 collection on Snapchat.  
  
Misha continues to push boundaries by using a direct-to-consumer, on-demand model that promotes sustainability by reducing waste and drastically shortens the time between a customer placing and receiving an order. Her brand marries interesting designs with innovative digital and production concepts that are celebrated by women who embrace their femininity whilst pursuing their goals.

Her work involves conducting human-centered design sessions that engage communities in identifying their specific challenges and co-creating tailored solutions that address their needs.

She excels in problem-solving, utilizing her keen attention to detail to navigate complex project landscapes and drive impactful outcomes. Among her key projects, Jessica has been at the forefront of developing digital platforms that enhance communication and information dissemination during disasters, ensuring that vulnerable populations have access to critical resources and support.  
  
In addition to her technical skills, Jessica is adept at volunteer management and event planning, often organizing workshops and training sessions that empower local stakeholders and build capacity within communities. Her commitment to fostering collaboration and innovation not only strengthens GDPC's mission but also contributes to a global movement towards more resilient societies. Through her leadership, Jessica is redefining how disaster preparedness is approached, making it more inclusive, effective, and sustainable.

About Stevie Nicks

Stevie Nicks is an iconic American singer-songwriter and film producer, known for her distinctive, husky voice, poetic songwriting, and captivating on-stage presence. With a career spanning over five decades, Nicks has consistently pushed the boundaries of music and left an indelible mark on the rock and pop genres. Her unique blend of rock, folk, and pop sensibilities, combined with her mystical persona, have captivated audiences around the world.  
  
Born Stephanie Lynn Nicks on May 26, 1948, in Phoenix, Arizona, Stevie Nicks showed an early love for music and performance. Growing up, she sang in a folk-rock band alongside her high school boyfriend, Lindsey Buckingham. The duo eventually caught the attention of Mick Fleetwood, the drummer of British rock band Fleetwood Mac, and were invited to join the group in 1975. This marked the beginning of Nicks' rise to fame and the start of her long and fruitful association with Fleetwood Mac.  
  
Nicks quickly became the focal point of Fleetwood Mac, with her enchanting stage presence and evocative songwriting. Her songs, such as "Rhiannon," "Landslide," and "Dreams," have become classics and have resonated with millions of fans worldwide. Nicks' lyrics often delve into deeply personal and emotional themes, exploring love, heartbreak, and self-discovery. Her poetic storytelling, combined with her ethereal vocals, have made her a legendary figure in the music industry.  
  
Beyond her contributions to Fleetwood Mac, Nicks has also enjoyed a successful solo career. In 1981, she released her debut solo album, "Bella Donna," which catapulted her into even greater stardom. The album featured timeless hits such as "Edge of Seventeen" and "Leather and Lace," showcasing Nicks' range as an artist and solidifying her status as a solo force to be reckoned with.  
  
Nicks' music is often characterized by its raw and emotional nature, drawing from personal experiences and channeling them into powerful melodies. Her distinct voice, with its earthy timbre and emotive delivery, adds an intimate quality to her songs, making them resonate deeply with listeners. Her influence can be heard in the works of numerous contemporary artists, who continue to draw inspiration from her unique style and musical contributions.  
  
In addition to her music career, Nicks has also dabbled in the world of film production. In 1981, she co-produced and co-wrote the soundtrack for the film "American Anthem." She continued her foray into film in the 1990s when she composed music for the hit animated movie "Twister" and for "Practical Magic," starring Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman. Nicks' ability to evoke emotions through music seamlessly translates into her work as a film producer, further showcasing her versatile talents.  
  
Throughout her illustrious career, Nicks has garnered numerous accolades and honors. She has been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame twice, both as a member of Fleetwood Mac in 1998 and as a solo artist in 2019. Her impact on the music industry is immeasurable, and her influence continues to shape the course of rock and popular music. Her dedication to her craft, coupled with her passion, creativity, and resilience, have made her an inspiration to countless aspiring artists.  
  
Stevie Nicks' legacy is one of greatness, as her music continues to touch the hearts and souls of listeners across generations. From her hauntingly beautiful ballads to her electrifying live performances, Nicks remains an enduring figure in the world of music. With her distinctive style and unwavering commitment to her art, she has solidified her place as one of the most influential singer-songwriters of all time. Stevie Nicks is an enduring icon, whose musical brilliance and captivating presence will continue to enchant audiences for years to come.

About Chuck Rosenberg

Chuck Rosenberg is a seasoned technology leader currently serving as the Head of the Advanced Technology Group at Pinterest. In this pivotal role, he oversees two critical teams: the Computer Vision team and the Applied Science team. His expertise in machine learning and computer vision drives the development of innovative algorithms that enhance user experiences on the platform. Under his leadership, the Computer Vision team has made significant strides in creating advanced visual search capabilities, including the Lens feature, which allows users to search for products using their camera and augmented reality (AR) technologies. This not only enriches the Pinterest experience but also empowers users to discover and engage with content in a more intuitive manner.  
  
Chuck’s commitment to harnessing artificial intelligence and algorithms has positioned Pinterest at the forefront of visual discovery and e-commerce. The Applied Science team, which he also leads, plays a crucial role in leveraging data-driven insights to inform product development and optimize user engagement strategies. By integrating cutting-edge research with practical applications, Chuck ensures that Pinterest remains a leader in the tech landscape, continually evolving to meet the needs of its diverse user base.  
  
His collaborative approach fosters a culture of innovation, where cross-functional teams work together to push the boundaries of what is possible with technology. As Pinterest continues to explore new frontiers in visual search and AI, Chuck Rosenberg's vision and expertise will undoubtedly play a key role in shaping the future of the platform and enhancing the way users connect with ideas and products.

About Michael Kors
------------------

Michael Kors is a world-renowned, award-winning designer of luxury accessories and ready-to-wear. His namesake company, established in 1981, currently produces a range of products under Michael Kors Collection, MICHAEL Michael Kors, and Michael Kors Mens, including accessories, ready-to-wear, footwear, wearable technology, watches, jewelry, and a full line of fragrance products. Michael Kors stores are operated in the most prestigious cities in the world, including New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, London, Milan, Paris, Munich, Dubai, Seoul, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Shanghai, and Rio de Janeiro. In addition, Michael Kors operates digital flagships across North America, Europe, and Asia, offering customers a seamless omnichannel experience.  
  
At the center of it all, is a designer who has created an enduring and iconic luxury lifestyle empire with a distinctive point of view and global reach. Michael Kors has a sharp focus on providing his customers with accessories and clothes that are consistently polished, chic, relaxed, and glamorous. Kors has also been the recipient of numerous industry awards and accolades within the fashion industry, been honored for his philanthropy, and earned the respect and affection of millions.  
  
The fashion designer also focuses on giving back. For more than 25 years he has been a passionate supporter of God’s Love We Deliver, a New York-based non-profit organization that cooks and delivers nutritious meals to people living with serious illnesses in and around New York City. Continuing his philanthropic efforts, in 2013 Michael Kors launched “Watch Hunger Stop,” partnering with the United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) to help fight world hunger. Proceeds from annual special-edition products, as well as from other targeted initiatives, help provide food to children through WFP’s school meals program. To date, Michael Kors has helped WFP deliver over twenty five million meals (and counting) to hungry children.

Nova is the global top-talent community that connects high-potentials with each other and with the best professional opportunities. The key to Nova is precisely the quality of our members, who have to go through a rigorous screening process before being accepted into the network. Our main line of business is B2B, with clients such as McKinsey, BCG, P&G, Novartis, Fever, or Vattenfall, which we help to attract and hire the best talent, faster, and more efficiently than existing solutions.  
  
We have a community of more than 20,000 people living in 95 countries around the world, from a wide variety of sectors such as technology, consulting, startups, finance, energy, and many more. About Nicholas Roeg

Nicholas Roeg was a visionary film director and cinematographer known for his unique and innovative approach to storytelling and visual style. With a career spanning over five decades, Roeg left an indelible mark on the world of cinema, influencing countless filmmakers and leaving behind a body of work that continues to captivate audiences to this day.  
  
Born in London in 1928, Roeg developed an early passion for photography and filmmaking, studying at the London School of Film Technique before beginning his career as a camera operator and cinematographer. His keen eye for composition and his ability to manipulate light and shadow would become hallmarks of his signature visual style, setting him apart from his contemporaries.  
  
Roeg's directorial debut came in 1970 with the critically acclaimed film "Performance," co-directed with Donald Cammell. The film, starring Mick Jagger and James Fox, was a radical departure from traditional storytelling, featuring fragmented narrative, surreal imagery, and a daring exploration of identity and sexuality. "Performance" was a bold statement of intent from Roeg, establishing him as a director unafraid to push the boundaries of cinematic storytelling.  
  
In the years that followed, Roeg continued to push the envelope with films such as "Walkabout" (1971), "Don't Look Now" (1973), and "The Man Who Fell to Earth" (1976). Each of these films displayed Roeg's uncanny ability to blend striking visuals with complex, thought-provoking narratives, earning him a reputation as one of the most daring and innovative filmmakers of his generation.  
  
As a cinematographer, Roeg's work was equally influential, with his keen understanding of light and shadow helping to elevate the visual language of cinema. His collaborations with directors such as François Truffaut, David Lean, and Richard Lester produced some of the most visually stunning films of their respective eras, further solidifying Roeg's reputation as a master of the craft.  
  
Roeg's impact on cinema extended beyond his work as a director and cinematographer. His influence can be seen in the work of contemporary filmmakers such as Christopher Nolan, Darren Aronofsky, and Nicolas Winding Refn, all of whom have cited Roeg as a major inspiration. His fearless approach to storytelling and his willingness to embrace the unconventional continue to resonate with audiences and filmmakers alike, ensuring that his legacy will endure for generations to come.  
  
In addition to his artistic achievements, Roeg's impact on the film industry was also felt through his mentoring of younger filmmakers and his willingness to push the boundaries of what was possible in the medium. He was an unapologetic champion of creative freedom and was unafraid to challenge the status quo, inspiring countless filmmakers to follow their artistic instincts and push the boundaries of what was possible in cinema.  
  
Nicholas Roeg's career was marked by a fearlessness and an uncompromising commitment to his artistic vision. His films continue to inspire and provoke audiences, challenging them to think differently about the medium and the stories it can tell. Roeg's passing in 2018 marked the end of an era for cinema, but his influence will continue to be felt for years to come, ensuring that his legacy as a pioneering director and cinematographer will endure for generations to come.

About Owen Wilson

Owen Wilson is an accomplished American actor known for his unique blend of charm, wit, and comedic timing. With his trademark laid-back persona and distinctive voice, Wilson has carved out a niche for himself in the entertainment industry, captivating audiences with his on-screen presence.  
  
Born in Dallas, Texas on November 18, 1968, Wilson developed a love for acting at a young age. He attended the University of Texas at Austin, where he met his future collaborator and friend, Wes Anderson. This serendipitous encounter would prove to be the catalyst for Wilson's rise to fame.  
  
Wilson first gained recognition for his breakout role in the 1996 film "Bottle Rocket," which he co-wrote with Anderson. The independent crime-comedy garnered critical acclaim and marked the beginning of a successful partnership between the two filmmakers. Wilson's portrayal of Dignan, an eccentric aspiring criminal, showcased his natural comedic talent and launched his career in Hollywood.  
  
Throughout his career, Wilson has starred in a multitude of films spanning various genres. From romantic comedies like "Wedding Crashers" and "You, Me and Dupree" to action-packed blockbusters such as "Behind Enemy Lines" and "Armageddon," Wilson's versatility as an actor knows no bounds. He effortlessly transitions between delivering hilarious one-liners to portraying heartfelt and vulnerable characters, captivating audiences with his range and authenticity.  
  
One of Wilson's most iconic roles came in 2001's "Zoolander," where he played the lovable and dim-witted male model, Hansel. Ashley McBryde is an American singer-songwriter that has been making waves in the country music scene with her unique blend of rock-infused storytelling and honest lyrics. Hailing from Arkansas, McBryde has been able to captivate audiences with her soulful voice and raw songwriting, earning her critical acclaim and a steadily growing fan base.  
  
McBryde's music is a reflection of her own life experiences, bringing a refreshing authenticity that resonates with listeners. Her songs often touch on themes of love, heartbreak, resilience, and the small-town struggles of everyday life. Whether she's singing about her own personal journey or painting vivid pictures of fictional characters, McBryde has a knack for creating music that feels genuine and relatable.  
  
One of McBryde's standout qualities is her powerful voice, which is both versatile and emotive. She can effortlessly transition from soft, introspective ballads to energetic, anthemic tracks that demand attention. With her rich, whiskey-soaked vocals, McBryde possesses a rare ability to convey raw emotions that strike a chord with listeners, making her performances truly captivating.  
  
In addition to her mesmerizing voice, McBryde's songwriting sets her apart from her contemporaries. Her lyrics are filled with vivid imagery and clever wordplay, showcasing her ability to tell compelling stories that truly connect with people. She has a knack for finding beauty in the mundane and can turn everyday moments into powerful narratives. McBryde's gift for storytelling shines through in songs like "American Scandal," where she recounts the struggles of a young couple trying to make ends meet, or "Girl Goin' Nowhere,” an anthem of self-belief and determination.  
  
McBryde's rise to success can be attributed, in part, to her relentless work ethic. She spent years honing her craft, playing gigs across the country and fine-tuning her sound. Her perseverance paid off when she released her major-label debut album, "Girl Going Nowhere," in 2018. The album was a critical success, earning McBryde a nomination for Best Country Album at the prestigious Grammy Awards. McBryde's talent was further recognized when she won the New Artist of the Year award at the 53rd Annual Country Music Association Awards.  
  
Beyond her musical talent, McBryde exudes a down-to-earth charm and relatability that endears her to fans. She radiates an infectious energy on stage, delivering powerful performances that leave audiences craving more. Whether she's performing at intimate venues or on big stages, McBryde's genuine connection with her audience is palpable. Her concerts are an immersive experience, where fans are invited into her world and get a glimpse of the heart and soul behind the music.

About Daré Bioscience, Inc.
---------------------------

Daré Bioscience® (NASDAQ: DARE) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to the advancement of innovative products for women's health. With eight potentially first-in-class women’s health products in development, we are committed to bring to market differentiated products designed to expand treatment options, improve outcomes, and facilitate a better quality of life for women.  
  
Vaginal drug delivery is often the optimum delivery approach to achieve these objectives, and IVR technology has become one of our preferred investigational platforms. Our portfolio features innovative IVR technologies including our non-hormonal contraceptive Ovaprene®, which we believe has the potential to disrupt the contraceptive landscape by providing protection for one month, without the use hormones, and our suite of ethylene-vinyl acetate (EVA) matrixed IVRs that can provide flexibility in terms of drug loading, drug delivery, and modulation of release rates across a wide array of molecules, hormones, peptides and proteins, facilitating new indications and applications of the technology.  
  
Daré’s EVA IVR technology includes DARE-HRT1 for dual hormone replacement as a potential treatment for the vasomotor symptoms of menopause and DARE-FRT1 for vaginal progesterone delivery in support of fertility and the prevention of pre-term birth. In addition to its novel IVR technologies, Daré is developing a topical formulation of sildenafil, the active ingredient in the blockbuster product Viagra®, for the treatment of female sexual arousal disorder (FSAD) as well as a novel vaginal formulation of the selective estrogen receptor modulator (SERM) tamoxifen to address and alleviate the symptoms of vulvar vaginal atrophy (VVA) for women diagnosed with and treated for hormone-receptor-positive (HR+) breast cancer.

About Orgill
------------

Orgill, Inc. is the world's largest independent hardlines distributor with annual sales of $3.5 billion. The privately owned company was founded in 1847 and is headquartered in Collierville, TN. Orgill serves more than 11,000 retail hardware stores, home centers, pro lumber dealers, and farm stores throughout the United States and Canada, and over 50 countries around the world.  
  
Orgill retailers have immediate access to more than 75,000 SKUs in each of its eight distribution centers. Drop Ship programs are available from the industry's leading manufacturers. Orgill's distribution facilities are among the newest and most efficient in the industry, with order accuracy rates of 99.6% and industry leading fill rates. Orgill operates one of the industry's largest truck fleets. 98% of Orgill customers receive their shipment on a scheduled Orgill truck with an Orgill driver within 48 hours of placing their order.  
  
More than 350 Orgill field representatives are strategically located throughout North America. These highly trained men and women work side by side with customers to help identify and address opportunities in the dealer's local market.  
Our field staff is supported by a highly skilled team of customer service specialists located in each distribution center, as well as our Collierville home office, who are always a phone call away.  
  
Orgill's sales have doubled over the past ten years, and are 15x what they were in 1990. The growth is a direct result of the company's focus on its mission to "Help Our Customers Be Successful".

As the CEO of Avantus Aerospace, Daniel Strangio brings over two decades of diverse leadership experience, seamlessly integrating his background as an Army Officer, Management Consultant, and Manufacturing Operations Leader into a robust vision for the company. Under his guidance, Avantus Aerospace has positioned itself as a key player in the aerospace industry, specializing in the production of C-Class parts, including fasteners, brackets, clips, and washers. Daniel's strategic approach emphasizes operational excellence and innovation, ensuring that the company not only meets but exceeds the rigorous demands of the aerospace sector.  
  
One of Daniel's key projects has been the implementation of advanced supply chain strategies that leverage statistical modeling and Six Sigma methodologies to enhance efficiency and reduce waste. His commitment to fostering cross-functional team leadership has resulted in a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement, empowering employees to drive performance and contribute to the company’s mission of becoming the preeminent aerospace supplier.  
  
Daniel's strong analytic problem-solving abilities have been instrumental in navigating the complexities of the aerospace market, enabling Avantus Aerospace to adapt swiftly to changing customer needs and industry trends. His dedication to logistics and operations management has led to significant improvements in production timelines and quality control, reinforcing the company's reputation for reliability and precision. As Avantus Aerospace continues to expand its footprint globally, Daniel Strangio's leadership and expertise will undoubtedly play a pivotal role in shaping its future success.

About Straus News
-----------------

Straus News publishes 17 local weekly newspapers and associated websites in contiguous towns in New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania. The circulation area covers Manhattan and Orange County in New York, Sussex and Passaic Counties in New Jersey and Pike County in Pennsylvania. Straus News also publishes Dirt, a magazine covering the local green scene.  
  
Straus News' newspapers are Our Town - Eastsider, The West Side Spirit - Westsider, Chelsea News - Chelsea Clinton News & Our Town - Downtowner in Manhattan; The Warwick Advertiser, The Photo News, The Chronicle in Orange County, NY; The Advertiser-News (North Edition), The Advertiser-News (South Edition), The Sparta Independent, The Township Journal, The West Milford Messenger in New Jersey and The Pike County Courier in Pennsylvania.  
  
Our newspapers and websites focus on local issues that matter to people's everyday lives, from concerns about schools and infrastructure spending to who's who in town and soccer scores. We pride ourselves on our commitment to reporting the tough local stories while highlighting the success and achievements in our neighborhoods.  
  
The newspapers have won numerous awards for news coverage and editorial and advertising excellence, including first place for in-depth reporting from the Suburban Newspaper Association for a series about heroin addiction entitled "High in Sussex County," and a prestigious National Education Writers Award for "Middle School Principal Tests Boundaries with Home Visit."  
  
The newspapers are distributed to more than 150,000 homes each week.

About City of Houston
---------------------

Home to a respected and energetic cultural arts scene, celebrated restaurants featuring flavors from 35 countries, world-renowned theater groups and the brains behind U.S. space exploration, Houston is a diverse metropolis brimming with personality.  
  
With nearly 21,000 concerts, plays, exhibitions and other arts programs presented in Houston annually, residents and visitors have access to a wide variety of cultural programs. On any given night, it's a safe bet that there's a show somewhere in Houston's Theater District. More than 2 million people visit the Downtown area each year to attend one of the city's world-class performances. Within the Museum District you will find eighteen world-class institutions, including the Menil Collection, Museum of Fine Arts, Houston and the Houston Museum of Natural Science are clustered in this area, drawing a reported seven million visitors to the district each year.  
  
Houston’s restaurant scene is as ethnically diverse as its 4 million residents. ForbesTraveler.com ranked Houston as one of the best restaurant cities in America. The city is jam-packed with more than 8,000 tempting eateries that feature culinary flavors from more than 35 countries.  
  
With 56,405 acres of total park space, Houston rates first among the nation's 10 most populous cities in total acreage of park land. The 165 public and private golf courses around the city and teams in nearly every major professional sport keep sports fever high year-round.  
  
The city also employs over 22,000 full-time staff to keep the city running. We are always looking for everyone from Engineers to IT Professionals, from entry level to executive level. Check back here for current postings, follow us on Facebook at www.facebook.com/cohcareers or on Twitter @COHCareers for all the up to date recruitment happenings!

How does the AI-enabled voice system work in the Drive Thru?

The AI-enabled voice system developed by McD Tech Labs utilizes advanced machine learning algorithms to understand and process customer orders in real-time. How does McD Tech Labs ensure the reliability and security of its AI systems?

McD Tech Labs prioritizes the reliability and security of its AI systems through rigorous testing and validation processes. This includes extensive simulations and real-world trials to ensure that the AI voice system performs accurately under various conditions. Additionally, the team implements robust security measures to protect customer data and ensure compliance with industry standards. By focusing on both performance and security, McD Tech Labs aims to build trust with customers and stakeholders alike.

About Benedict Anderson

Benedict Anderson was an Irish political scientist and historian known for his influential work on nationalism and Southeast Asian studies. Born in 1936 in Kunming, China, Anderson spent much of his early life in California before ultimately settling in Ireland. He was a highly respected academic figure whose work had a profound impact on the understanding of national identity and politics.  
  
One of Anderson's most famous contributions to the field of political science and history is his 1983 book "Imagined Communities: Reflections on the Origin and Spread of Nationalism." In this seminal work, Anderson explores the emergence and spread of nationalism, arguing that nations are socially constructed and imagined communities. He posited that the concept of a nation is a modern phenomenon, created through the convergence of print capitalism, the rise of vernacular languages, and the decline of religious and dynastic empires. Anderson's work challenged traditional understandings of nationalism and paved the way for new perspectives on the subject.  
  
In addition to his work on nationalism, Anderson also made significant contributions to the study of Southeast Asian history and politics. He was a renowned expert on the region and its complex dynamics, and his scholarship has greatly informed the understanding of Southeast Asian societies. His work on Indonesia, in particular, has been widely praised for its incisive analysis and deep understanding of the country's history and politics.  
  
Anderson's impact in the field of political science and history extended far beyond his academic achievements. He was known for his engaging writing style and ability to communicate complex ideas in a clear and accessible manner. This made his work highly influential among both scholars and the general public, cementing his reputation as a leading voice in his field.  
  
Throughout his career, Anderson held academic positions at prestigious institutions around the world, including Cornell University, Ohio University, and University of California, Berkeley. He was also a visiting professor at numerous universities, further disseminating his ideas and making a lasting impression on the academic community. His legacy continues to be felt in the study of nationalism, Southeast Asian history, and beyond.  
  
Anderson's impact on political science and history cannot be overstated. His groundbreaking work on nationalism and Southeast Asian studies continues to shape scholarly discourse and inspire new generations of researchers. As a prolific writer and engaging thinker, Anderson left an indelible mark on his field, and his contributions will be remembered for years to come. Katherine Schwarzenegger is a force to be reckoned with in the literary world. An accomplished American author, she has made a name for herself through her powerful and thought-provoking works. With her unique perspective and powerful storytelling abilities, she has captivated readers and established herself as a prominent voice in contemporary literature.  
  
The daughter of Hollywood icon Arnold Schwarzenegger and journalist Maria Shriver, Katherine grew up in a world where fame and success were the norm. However, she never allowed herself to be overshadowed by her famous lineage. Instead, she has carved her own path and made a mark as an author, demonstrating her immense talent and love for the written word.  
  
Katherine's writing explores a wide range of topics, all with a focus on personal growth, empowerment, and inspiring others to live a meaningful life. She delves deep into the complexities of relationships, self-discovery, and finding one's purpose, drawing from her own experiences and those of others. Through her words, she offers guidance, support, and encouragement to her readers, igniting a spark within them to chase their dreams and live their best lives.  
  
One of Katherine's most notable works is her debut book, "Rock What You've Got: Secrets to Loving Your Inner and Outer Beauty from Someone Who's Been There and Back." Released in 2010, this empowering self-help book resonated with readers of all ages. In it, she encourages her audience to embrace their unique qualities and to love themselves unconditionally. Drawing from her own struggles with body image and self-esteem, Katherine shares her personal journey to self-acceptance, offering practical tips and insights that readers can apply to their own lives. The book struck a chord with many, propelling Katherine into the spotlight as a voice of inspiration and positivity.  
  
Following the success of her debut, Katherine went on to co-author "I Just Graduated... Now What?: Honest Answers from Those Who Have Been There" with fellow writer and entrepreneur Julie Fishman. Published in 2014, this book serves as a guide for recent graduates navigating the uncertainties of post-college life. Full of practical advice, personal anecdotes, and insightful interviews with successful individuals from various fields, Katherine and Julie provide a roadmap for young adults seeking direction and fulfillment in their careers and personal lives.  
  
Katherine's writing not only captures the hearts of readers but also sparks important conversations about social issues. In her book "Maverick and Me," published in 2017, she explores the powerful bond between humans and animals, particularly the impact of adopting rescue dogs. Drawing from her own experiences as a dog lover and adopting her pet Maverick, Katherine delves into the heartwarming stories of other rescue dogs and their impact on the lives of their adopters. The book not only sheds light on the importance of animal rescue but also advocates for responsible pet ownership and the immense benefits of the human-animal bond.  
  
In addition to her books, Katherine is an avid blogger and uses her platform to promote positive change in the world. With her writing, she encourages her readers to live with purpose, authenticity, and compassion. Through her thought-provoking articles, she addresses various topics, including mental health, well-being, social issues, and personal growth.  
  
Katherine Schwarzenegger has become an influential figure in contemporary literature. Her ability to connect with readers and provide them with tools for personal growth and inspiration is a testament to her talent as a writer. With her unique perspective, she has successfully explored a wide range of topics, leaving a lasting impact on her audience. He plays a critical role in assisting investors with due diligence analysis, ensuring that potential investments align with both financial goals and sustainability objectives. About PGA National Resort & Spa
-------------------------------

PGA National Resort is a world-class golf, spa, vacation and meeting destination. With 90 holes of championship golf on five courses, including the famed Champion Course, we are home to the popular PGA TOUR Honda Classic and past host of the Ryder Cup, PGA Championship and several Senior PGA Championships. The Champion Course showcases the legendary “Bear Trap” – one of the most difficult three-hole stretches in the game. Holes 15, 16 and 17 are where designer Jack Nicklaus famously said, “It should be won or lost right here.” The legendary resort also has the unique distinction of being home to both the David Leadbetter Golf Academy and Dave Pelz Scoring Game School, along with offering a PGA TOUR-level fitting experience at the PGA National Club Fitting Lab. At the off-site Estates Course, we additionally offer Every Ball Counts – the world’s first science-based, a statistics-driven training system for golf improvement.PGA National features customized suites ideal for weddings, golf “buddy trips” and spa aficionados. Its numerous multi-use settings include a permanent, lakeside wedding venue with stunning vistas; scenic Lakeside Lawn perfect for receptions; iDeck ideal for indoor/outdoor dining and entertaining; and the 19th hole bar and grill named “Bar 91.” Other distinguishing highlights include a 33,000-square-foot state-of-the-art Sports & Racquet Club with 19 Har-Tru tennis courts; 40,000 square-feet of the self-contained conference and event space; and eight on-site restaurants and lounges.On behalf of our staff, we look forward to welcoming you to our Palm Beach Gardens, Florida paradise.

The Seattle Mariners are a professional baseball team founded in 1977. The Mariners have three focuses for the present and future:  
  
• A commitment to winning,  
• A commitment to our fans,  
• A commitment to the Northwest community.  
  
The top priority for the entire Seattle Mariners organization is to bring multiple World Series Championships to Seattle. Being competitive or simply having a winning record is not good enough. Our long-range strategy is in place and is already beginning to show results.  
  
At the same time, the Mariners strive to provide an entertaining product that can be enjoyed by Mariners fans wherever they are in the world. We will maintain T-Mobile Park in first-class condition and create an atmosphere where all fans are welcome and can have an enjoyable time.  
  
Finally, we value our place in the Pacific Northwest community and strive to make a difference in the lives of the people of the region. Through Mariners Care, our non-profit foundation, and other endeavors, we take seriously our role as a leader in efforts to make a real and lasting impact in our community.

Instacart makes it possible for millions of people to get the groceries they need from the retailers they love, and for approximately 600,000 Instacart shoppers to earn by picking, packing and delivering orders on their own flexible schedule. The Instacart Platform offers retailers a suite of enterprise-grade technology products and services to power their e-commerce experiences, fulfill orders, digitize brick-and-mortar stores, provide advertising services, and glean insights. With Instacart Ads, thousands of CPG brands – from category leaders to emerging brands – partner with the company to connect directly with consumers online, right at the point of purchase. With Instacart Health, the company is providing tools to increase nutrition security, make healthy choices easier for consumers, and expand the role that food can play in improving health outcomes. To become a member of The Nautical Institute, you can visit the membership section of our website. What types of training programs does The Nautical Institute accredit?

The Nautical Institute accredits a wide range of maritime technical training programs. These include courses related to navigation, ship management, safety management, and environmental protection, among others. The accreditation process ensures that training providers meet high standards of quality and relevance, helping to ensure that maritime professionals receive the best possible education and training to advance their careers.

What events does The Nautical Institute organize for maritime professionals?

The Nautical Institute organizes a variety of events for maritime professionals, including conferences, seminars, and workshops. These events provide opportunities for networking, sharing knowledge, and discussing current issues in the maritime industry. Participants can engage with experts, gain insights into best practices, and stay updated on the latest developments in maritime regulations and technology.

How does The Nautical Institute support maritime professionals in their career development?

The Nautical Institute supports maritime professionals in their career development through various initiatives, including professional development programs, mentorship opportunities, and access to a global network of maritime experts. About Illinois Farm Bureau
--------------------------

Illinois Farm Bureau® is a membership organization controlled by farmers who join IFB® through their county Farm Bureau. There are 95 county organizations in Illinois. IFB is a not for profit corporation. IFB’s legal name is the Illinois Agricultural Association which was founded in 1916 by a group of farmers who met at the University of Illinois to discuss the need for education, better information, and more effective farming practices. Today, IFB represents two out of three Illinois farmers.  
  
Illinois Farm Bureau:  
• Shares the farmer’s story to consumers.  
• Updates members on new technology and information that impacts agriculture.  
• Represents farmers in local, state, and national legislative & political activities.  
• Provides marketing and education services to help IFB members improve their net farm income.  
  
Illinois Farm Bureau is a member of the American Farm Bureau Federation®, a national organization of farmers and ranchers including Farm Bureaus in all 50 states and Puerto Rico, and is responsible for Farm Bureau® membership and programs within Illinois. Illinois Farm Bureau® programs and services are available only to Farm Bureau® members within Illinois. FARM BUREAU® and FB® are registered service marks owned by the American Farm Bureau Federation.  
  
For more information, please visit our website:  
http://www.ilfb.org & www.WatchUsGrow.org

About Arbeidslivsressurs
------------------------

Arbeidslivsressurs, headquartered in Brynsengveien 2, Oslo, is a prominent player in the Norwegian labor market, dedicated to enhancing employment opportunities and supporting individuals in their career journeys. Established on June 7, 2017, the organization operates under the auspices of NAV, Norway's Labor and Welfare Administration, and has expanded its reach with offices in key locations including Porsgrunn, Trondheim, Egersund, Bryne, and Kopervik.  
  
As a recognized tiltaksarrangør (measure organizer), Arbeidslivsressurs specializes in delivering tailored employment initiatives designed to meet the diverse needs of job seekers. Their flagship programs include REFINO in Grenland, which focuses on refining skills and enhancing employability, and comprehensive follow-up services in Trondheim that ensure ongoing support for participants. Additionally, the organization offers avklaring (clarification) services across three locations in Rogaland, aimed at assessing individual capabilities and aligning them with suitable job opportunities.  
  
With a commitment to fostering a more inclusive workforce, Arbeidslivsressurs employs innovative methodologies and technologies to facilitate effective job placements and career development. Their approach not only addresses the immediate needs of job seekers but also contributes to long-term workforce sustainability in various industries. By leveraging partnerships with local businesses and community organizations, Arbeidslivsressurs plays a vital role in bridging the gap between employers and potential employees, ultimately driving positive outcomes in the Norwegian labor market. With a growing presence and a dedicated team, Arbeidslivsressurs continues to make significant strides in empowering individuals to achieve their professional goals.

About Hemchandracharya North Gujarat University
-----------------------------------------------

The geographical jurisdiction of the North Gujarat University is constituted of four districts Mehsana, Patan, Banaskantha and Sabarkantha. Each one of the four district, has its own distinct heritage. Geographically a part of the whole area is towards the desert of Kutchh, the North Eastern side are rocky regions of forest populated by the tribals. The economy of the area is mainly agricultural. There are a ew towns in the region and no big cities. The rest of the population lives in illages. With a view to catering to the peculiar cultural and educational needs of the area, North Gujarat University was established by the Governor's Ordinance No. 5 of 1986 dated 17.5.1986. Subsequently, the North Gujarat University Act No.22 of 1986 was passed by the Legislative Assembly of Gujarat, on 11/9/86.The University has been functioning since then and growing and expanding steadily.  
  
The Legislative Assembly of Gujarat State has passing the bill in the year 2003 has renamed The North Gujarat University (NGU) as "HEMCHANDRACHARYA NORTH GUJARAT UNIVERSITY (HNGU)".  
  
The University is expected to combine, more precisely, synthesize programmes of Human Resource Development anchored on positive attributes of inherited cultural ethos with needed specialist professional skills and competence to meet with socio-economic needs with emphasis on imbibing habits of learning to learn in the field of higher education.

----------------------------------------

The UC Berkeley College of Engineering stands as a beacon of innovation and excellence in the field of engineering education. Located in the heart of Berkeley, California, the college is renowned for its commitment to developing the next generation of leaders and pioneers. With a rich history of impactful contributions—ranging from the engineering feats that brought water to California's agricultural lands to the groundbreaking advancements in microelectronics that fueled Silicon Valley—Berkeley Engineering continues to shape the future of technology and society.  
  
The college's mission is clear: to educate aspiring engineers for careers marked by leadership and innovation, to expand the frontiers of engineering knowledge through original research, and to serve the public good by collaborating with industry, government, and the engineering profession. Berkeley Engineering is home to a diverse community of students and faculty, all driven by a shared passion for solving complex problems and making a difference in the world.  
  
As technology evolves at an unprecedented pace, the opportunities for engineering advancements to benefit society are greater than ever. The UC Berkeley College of Engineering is uniquely positioned to harness these opportunities, fostering an environment where creativity and technical expertise flourish. Prospective students and researchers are drawn to the college not only for its outstanding reputation and internationally recognized faculty but also for the chance to engage with a vibrant community dedicated to innovation. For those interested in learning more about the faculty, a comprehensive UC Berkeley College Of Engineering teachers list is available on their official website, showcasing the distinguished educators who guide and inspire the next generation of engineers.

About Baylor Scott & White Health
---------------------------------

Baylor Scott & White Health, headquartered in Dallas, Texas, stands as the largest not-for-profit health system in the state, dedicated to enhancing the health and well-being of individuals, families, and communities across Texas. With a rich history rooted in Christian ministry, the organization has evolved over more than a century to serve over three million Texans through an extensive integrated delivery network. This network encompasses 51 hospitals and more than 1,100 access points, including flagship academic medical centers in Dallas, Fort Worth, and Temple, ensuring that quality healthcare is both accessible and affordable.  
  
Baylor Scott & White offers a comprehensive range of services, from primary care to award-winning specialty care, addressing diverse health needs across various demographics. The system is committed to innovation in healthcare delivery, leveraging advanced technologies such as the MyBSWHealth digital health platform, which enhances patient engagement and streamlines access to care. Additionally, the Baylor Scott & White Health Plan and the Baylor Scott & White Research Institute contribute to the system's mission by promoting health insurance solutions and pioneering medical research, respectively. The Baylor Scott & White Quality Alliance further emphasizes the organization's commitment to delivering high-quality care through collaborative efforts aimed at improving patient outcomes. By integrating these services and technologies, Baylor Scott & White Health continues to lead the way in transforming healthcare delivery, ensuring that every Texan has the opportunity to achieve optimal health. For more than 40 years, Richland College has focused on teaching, learning and community building. In recognition of these efforts, the White House and the Dept. of Commerce named Richland a 2005 recipient of the Malcolm Baldrige National Quality Award, the only community college to have received this award. Richland helps students build their future through courses that can be applied to the first two years of a baccalaureate degree, one- or two-year certificates in a number of career fields, and training in the latest technology for students who want to advance in their current careers. The student body of approximately 20,000 college credit students and about 5,000 continuing education students at Richland is internationally and ethnically diverse, speaking more than 79 first languages. Richland College also offers students living in contiguous counties the opportunity to enroll in Richland Collegiate High School (RCHS), one of the first junior-senior dual credit charter high schools administered by a community college. The TEA Exemplary-rated RCHS has capacity for up to 900 students who may simultaneously earn a high school diploma and an associate degree.

About Josh Groban

Josh Groban is an exceptional American singer and songwriter whose voice has captivated audiences worldwide. Groban's extraordinary talent, combined with his charming personality and genuine love for his craft, has earned him a dedicated following and numerous accolades throughout his career.  
  
Born in Los Angeles, California, on February 27, 1981, Groban's musical journey began at a young age. He discovered his passion for singing while attending the prestigious Los Angeles County High School for the Arts. It was during this time that Groban caught the attention of Grammy-winning producer David Foster, who would become instrumental in launching his career.  
  
In 2001, Groban had his breakthrough moment when he stood in for Andrea Bocelli during a Grammy rehearsal. His performance caught the ear of Foster, who instantly recognized his potential. Foster invited Groban to sing "The Prayer" alongside Celine Dion at the 1999 Grammy Awards telecast, and the world took notice. This extraordinary opportunity led to Groban signing a record deal with Warner Bros. Records, where he began working on his debut album, "Josh Groban."  
  
Released in 2001, "Josh Groban" quickly became a sensation, reaching number eight on the Billboard 200 chart. The album showcased Groban's heavenly voice, characterized by its rich timbre and incredible range. His ability to effortlessly transition from soaring high notes to resonant low tones captured the hearts of millions, earning him the title of the next great male vocalist.  
  
With songs like "You're Still You" and "To Where You Are," Groban's debut album resonated with audiences on a deep emotional level. His velvety vocals conveyed a sense of vulnerability and passion that had been missing from the music scene, and listeners flocked to his soul-stirring melodies. "Josh Groban" went on to be certified double platinum, and the world fell in love with this gifted artist.  
  
In the years that followed, Groban continued to shine in both the classical and pop worlds. His sophomore album, "Closer," released in 2003, solidified his status as a musical superstar. The album featured collaborations with renowned violinist Joshua Bell and the iconic Italian singer, Laura Pausini. Groban's rendition of Don McLean's classic "Vincent (Starry, Starry Night)" remains one of his most beloved performances, showcasing his ability to breathe new life into beloved classics.  
  
Groban's third studio album, "Awake," released in 2006, further showcased his versatility as an artist. With songs like "You Are Loved (Don't Give Up)" and "February Song," he continued to enchant audiences with his heartfelt lyrics and powerful vocals. This album demonstrated Groban's ability to tell stories through his music, providing listeners with a sense of hope and comfort.  
  
Beyond his music, Groban is known for his philanthropic endeavors as well. He established the Find Your Light Foundation in 2011, which focuses on enriching the lives of young people through arts education. Groban's dedication to his craft and his desire to make a positive impact on the world have not gone unnoticed. Alongside his numerous Grammy nominations, he has been honored with awards such as the Billboard Music Awards' Achievement Award and the American Music Awards' Favorite Adult Contemporary Artist. His success in the entertainment industry, marked by his warm-hearted and genuine demeanor, has only further endeared him to his fans.  
  
Josh Groban is undeniably a force to be reckoned with in the music industry. His awe-inspiring vocal prowess, combined with his passion for creating meaningful music, makes him a true standout. Whether he is singing heartfelt ballads, classical masterpieces, or crafting his own compositions, Groban's ability to connect with listeners on an emotional level is nothing short of extraordinary. About Shasta Community Health Center
------------------------------------

Shasta Community Health Center is a non-profit primary health care system. SCHC is based in Redding California and serves Shasta and surrounding counties and communities since 1988. MISSION STATEMENT Shasta Community Health Center’s mission is to provide quality health care services to the medically underserved populations of our communities. VISION STATEMENT Shasta Community Health Center, working with private and public health partners, and by leveraging and efficiently using its limited resources, will help to create a seamless system of access to compassionate, high quality cost-effective primary and preventive health care for all residents of the communities it serves. Shasta Community Health Center strives to improve the health status within the communities it serves, particularly for those residents who are economically or otherwise disadvantaged. OUR VALUES CARING AND COMPASSION: We treat those we serve and one another with concern, kindness and respect. HONESTY AND INTEGRITY: We act openly and truthfully in everything we do. TEAMWORK: We work together cooperatively, recognizing the power of our combined efforts exceeds what we can accomplish individually. COMMUNITY: We acknowledge our vital role in local communities, and we seek to understand and serve their needs. EXCELLENCE AND QUALITY: We are committed to quality and to adding value in every aspect of our work, and we strive to exceed the expectations of our customers. EDUCATION, TEACHING AND TRAINING: We strive to create an educational environment for our patients, our employees and for the training of medical professionals dedicated to serving the disadvantaged.

Who is the CEO of Shasta Community Health Center?

.

What services does Shasta Community Health Center offer?

Shasta Community Health Center (SCHC) provides a wide range of services to meet the health care needs of the community. These services include primary care, urgent care, dental care, neuropsychiatry, early intervention services for HIV, youth outreach programs, and patient education. SCHC is dedicated to providing comprehensive health care to individuals and families in Shasta and surrounding counties.

How can I access urgent care services at SCHC?

To access urgent care services at Shasta Community Health Center, you can visit our facility during operating hours. No appointment is necessary for urgent care, but we recommend arriving early to minimize wait times. For more information on hours of operation and specific services offered, please visit our website or contact our office directly.

Does SCHC accept insurance, and what payment options are available?

Yes, Shasta Community Health Center accepts a variety of insurance plans, including Medi-Cal and Medicare. For those without insurance, SCHC offers a sliding fee scale based on income to ensure that everyone has access to necessary health care services. We also accept self-pay options and can assist you in exploring financial assistance programs.

What is the Early Intervention Services (EIS) program, and who is it for?

The Early Intervention Services (EIS) program at Shasta Community Health Center is designed to support individuals who are at risk for or living with HIV. The program provides comprehensive services, including testing, counseling, medical care, and support services to help individuals manage their health and well-being. EIS is available to anyone in the community, regardless of their insurance status.

How can I get involved with SCHC's youth outreach programs?

Shasta Community Health Center's youth outreach programs aim to engage and support young people in the community. To get involved, you can volunteer your time, participate in community events, or refer youth who may benefit from our services. For more information on current programs and how to participate, please contact our outreach coordinator through our website.

What resources does SCHC provide for patient education?

Shasta Community Health Center is committed to patient education and empowerment. We provide a variety of resources, including workshops, informational materials, and one-on-one counseling sessions to help patients understand their health conditions and treatment options. Our goal is to equip patients with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions about their health care.

About Prime Focus World
-----------------------

Prime Focus World (PFW) is a filmmaking partner to international studios and film production companies, providing world-class creative services, pioneering technology services and intelligent financial solutions on a global scale.  
  
We provide VFX:  
In 2014, PFW merged its VFX business with Double Negative (Dneg), an Academy Award® winning VFX industry leader with facilities in London, Vancouver and Mumbai. Dneg’s VFX credits include ‘Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice’, ‘Ex Machina’ (Academy Award winner), ‘Spectre’, ‘The Hunger Games: Mockingjay Part 2’, ‘Interstellar’ (Academy Award / BAFTA winner), ‘Avengers: Age of Ultron’, ‘Godzilla’ and ‘Inception’ (Academy Award / BAFTA winner). For more information on Double Negative's services and a full credit list, please visit www.dneg.com  
  
We provide Stereo Conversion:  
PFW was the first company in the world to convert a full Hollywood film from 2D to 3D, and its patented, award-winning stereo conversion process has been used on more blockbuster Hollywood films than any other. Stereo conversion credits include ‘Captain America: Civil War’, ‘The Martian’, ‘Ant-Man’, ‘Terminator: Genisys’, ‘Avengers: Age of Ultron’, ‘Guardians of the Galaxy’ (Advanced Imaging Society winner), ‘Transformers: Age of Extinction’, ‘Star Wars: Episodes I-III’ and ‘Gravity’ (International 3D Society winner).  
  
We provide Animation:  
From script to screen, PFW partners with production companies and brands to develop and deliver beautifully animated CG content, offering the scale and experience to deal with projects of any size. Animation credits include a full-length feature film and over forty episodes of a fully CG animated TV show for a major global toy brand.  
  
Prime Focus World is the creative services division of Prime Focus Limited (BSE code: 532748), the world’s largest integrated media services company.

About General Dynamics NASSCO
-----------------------------

General Dynamics NASSCO traces its beginnings to the working waterfront of beautiful and historic San Diego Bay. The company has been designing and building ships in San Diego’s industrial heart since 1960 and is the only full service shipyard on the West Coast of the United States.  
  
Today, General Dynamics NASSCO has locations on the West and East Coasts. We specialize in the design and construction of auxiliary and support ships for the U.S. Navy, and oil tankers and dry cargo carriers for commercial markets. NASSCO is also a major provider of repair services for the U.S. Navy’s global force for good, with capabilities in San Diego, Norfolk, Mayport and Bremerton.

Liz Cheney is a prominent figure in American politics, known for her unwavering commitment to conservative principles and her influential position as a former United States Representative. Born into a political family, Cheney has demonstrated both tenacity and intellectual rigour throughout her career, earning her a reputation as a resolute defender of liberty and democratic values.  
  
Cheney's journey into politics began during her formative years, as the daughter of former Vice President of the United States, Dick Cheney. Growing up in a politically charged environment, she developed a deep understanding of the nation's inner workings and its profound impact on the lives of everyday Americans. Inspired by her family's commitment to public service, Liz Cheney forged her own path, focusing on advancing conservative ideology and safeguarding the nation.  
  
A graduate of the University of Chicago and the University of Denver College of Law, Cheney's academic prowess equipped her with the knowledge and skills necessary to excel in the political arena. Following her education, she worked as an attorney and held positions in the U.S. State Department under President George W. Bush, where she gained valuable experience in international relations and national security affairs.  
  
In 2016, Cheney made her political debut when she successfully ran for Wyoming's sole seat in the United States House of Representatives, representing the state's at-large congressional district. Her election marked an important milestone in her career, as she became the first woman to hold this position in Wyoming's history. Passionate about upholding conservative principles, Cheney used her platform to champion limited government, fiscal responsibility, and a strong national defense. She quickly gained recognition as an influential voice in the Republican Party and was elected Chair of the House Republican Conference in 2019, making her the third-highest-ranking Republican in the House of Representatives.  
  
During her time in Congress, Cheney was an outspoken advocate for American exceptionalism and the importance of maintaining a strong national defense. She consistently called for robust military funding, arguing that a strong military is essential for both the nation's security and its standing on the global stage. Cheney's comprehensive understanding of international relations allowed her to navigate complex geopolitical issues with ease and propose effective policies that protected American interests.  
  
Furthermore, Cheney's commitment to safeguarding American values and democracy was particularly evident during the impeachment proceedings against former President Donald Trump in 2019-2021. Despite facing immense pressure within her own party, Cheney stood firmly behind her convictions and voted to impeach Trump for incitement of insurrection following the storming of the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021. Her principled stance demonstrated her unwavering belief in the importance of accountability, regardless of partisan sentiment, and solidified her reputation as a fearless leader unafraid to challenge the status quo.  
  
While Cheney's tenure in Congress was marked by numerous accomplishments, it was not without controversy. Her outspoken criticism of Donald Trump and his role in perpetuating false claims of election fraud and the deadly Capitol riot led to a fracture within the Republican Party itself. Despite facing backlash from fellow Republicans and ultimately being removed from her leadership role, Cheney remained steadfast in her beliefs, vowing to continue fighting for truth, constitutional principles, and the future of the Republican Party.  
  
Beyond her political career, Liz Cheney is a devoted wife and mother. Married to attorney Philip Perry, with whom she has five children, Cheney is known for her ability to balance her personal and professional life effectively. Her dedication to her family serves as a testament to her prioritization of traditional conservative values and reinforces her understanding of the everyday concerns and aspirations of the American people.  
  
In conclusion, Liz Cheney's impact on American politics cannot be overstated. Her unwavering commitment to conservative principles, her fearless defense of American democracy, and her exceptional leadership skills have positioned her as a prominent figure in the Republican Party. Cheney's journey from a politically influential family to becoming the first woman to represent Wyoming in Congress reflects her determination to uphold conservative values while promoting bipartisan dialogue. VAC AERO offers vacuum heat treating and coating services and manufactures vacuum furnaces for aerospace and high-tech industries worldwide. Furnace Manufacturing: The Furnace Manufacturing Division specializes in the design and manufacture of a range of high-temperature gas quench vacuum furnace systems and controls for standard or custom heat treating applications.  
  
Coatings: The Coatings Division offers a variety of coating processes and applications for protection and restoration of new and service-exposed turbine engine and airframe components both small and large. Services provided include; plasma and HVOF spray coatings, inorganic paint and pack coatings as well as grinding.  
  
Heat Treating: VAC AERO is a pioneer vacuum heat treater since 1959. Extensive knowledge and experience coupled with a unique approach to understanding each client’s challenging requirements have positioned VAC AERO as a leading provider of innovative thermal processing solutions.

About Fundació Politècnica de Catalunya
---------------------------------------

La Fundació Politècnica de Catalunya (FPC) es la institución creada por la Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC) para fomentar y promover las actividades de formación permanente de los profesionales de las empresas y de los sectores económicos y sociales de Cataluña.  
  
De acuerdo con estos objetivos, desde su creación en 1994 la Fundació Politècnica de Catalunya ha promovido y gestionado la extensa oferta de programas de la UPC que están orientados al desarrollo profesional. Desde entonces, más de 80.000 profesionales han cursado alguno de sus másteres, posgrados, cursos de especialización y seminarios en los diferentes ámbitos de la ingeniería y la arquitectura.  
  
Por otro lado, la Fundació Politècnica de Catalunya también desarrolla actividad formativa en el campo de la tecnología multimedia, en el cual, a través del Centro de la Imagen y la Tecnología Multimedia (CITM), ofrece enseñanzas de grado de la UPC en este ámbito, así como otros programas de formación y actividades de transferencia de conocimiento.  
  
http://www.fpc.upc.edu/

His proficiency in market evaluation and provider network management has allowed Baylor Scott & White Health to strategically position itself within the competitive healthcare landscape, ensuring that it remains at the forefront of innovation and patient care excellence.

His commitment to enhancing healthcare delivery through strategic initiatives not only bolsters the organization’s performance but also contributes to improved patient outcomes and satisfaction.
